plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-link-open

在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端里**右键链接，用默认浏览器打开**。

## 功能

- 在任意 http/https 链接上右键，弹出小菜单：
  - **在默认浏览器中打开**
  - **复制链接**
- 普通文字的右键不受影响。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:starash07/dsh-link-open
```

也可以下载 Release 里的 `dsh-link-open-1.0.0.tgz`，用本地路径安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<tgz 的绝对路径>
```

安装后重启桌面客户端。

## 说明

- 打开链接走宿主本地接口，由系统默认浏览器处理（Windows 用 `rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler`）。
- 仅处理 `http` / `https`，其他协议（`file:`、`dsh:` 等）不接管。
- 仅验证于 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 桌面端（Electron 44）。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每 N 个 agent 步骤在对话里插一次进度小结（正在做什么 / 已完成什么 / 接下来做什么 / 卡点），说完自动继续，不产生额外回合。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-step-pause

每 N 个 agent 步骤**暂停一次**，在对话里用几行说明「正在做什么 / 已完成什么 / 接下来做什么 / 卡点」，
说完**不停下来等确认**，直接继续原任务。

> Plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every N agent steps, interrupt the turn with a short progress
> report, then keep going on its own. No document is produced — the report is plain chat text.

![插件页配置页](docs/config-page.png)

---

## 它解决什么问题

长任务跑到第 30、40 步时，你往往不知道它现在在干什么、卡在哪、还要多久。
这个插件按固定节奏把进度**主动说出来**，而且不需要你回一句话才继续：

- 每满 N 步，往**当前步骤的输入批次**里追加一条消息，要求模型先汇报再继续；
- 因为它属于「本步输入」而不是新任务，所以**不产生额外回合**，汇报和后续动作在同一次响应里完成；
- 不会把任务挂成「等待用户确认」，也不会打断正在跑的工具调用（边界本来就是两次思考之间）。

## 安装

桌面版**不要**用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 直接改 profile —— 它由应用内的插件管理器独占。二选一：

1. **应用内安装**：`设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 从本地目录`，选这个仓库的根目录；
2. **命令行**（只对非 desktop 的 profile）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add file:<这个仓库的绝对路径>
```

装完按 `文件 → 退出` **完全退出应用**再启动（不是刷新页面）。

## 配置

装好后：`设置 → 插件 → 分步暂停 → › → 配置`。四个字段都带说明与草稿态：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。关掉后插件仍然加载，但不再汇报 |
| `everyNSteps` | `10` | 每多少步汇报一次（按轮次内的步骤计，1–500） |
| `maxReportsPerTurn` | `0` | 每轮最多汇报几次；`0` 表示不限制（兜底防失控轮次刷屏） |
| `prompt` | 见下 | 注入的提示词，支持 `{{step}}` `{{every}}` `{{turn}}` |

改动**保存即生效，不用重启**：字段声明为 `volatile()`，主机每一步都重新读值。
保存会写进当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-step-pause
  name: dsh-step-pause
  config:
    everyNSteps: 6
```

不想要配置页的话，直接手写上面这段完全等价。

默认提示词：

```text
[自动 · 分步暂停 · 第 {{step}} 步（每 {{every}} 步一次）]
先暂停手上的工作，直接在对话正文里用 5-10 行说明当前进度，然后立刻继续原任务：
1. 正在做什么：当前任务与所处步骤
2. 已完成什么：本轮已完成的动作或产出
3. 接下来做什么：下一步计划
4. 卡点：需要我决策或补充信息的地方（没有就写「无」）

要求：直接在回复正文里写，不要新建或修改任何文档/计划文件；
说完不要停下来等我确认，继续把原任务做完。
```

## 工作原理

挂在驱动器的步骤边界 `agent/pre-step`（waterfall）上：

```js
ctx.on('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => {
  const decision = await next()                       // 先拿到本来的决策
  if (decision.kind !== 'enter') return decision      // reject / aborted 原样透传
  return { ...decision, messages: [...decision.messages, notice] }
}, { prepend: true })
```

计数用 `(turn, step)` 去重，换轮重置；`payload` 里带 `agent`，所以子 agent 也会各自计数
（不想要就按 `agent.id` 过滤）。

### 一个必须踩对的细节：`source.kind` 必须是 `user`

DSH 客户端按消息来源决定怎么渲染（`dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `input-message` 分类）：

```js
if (event.data.source.kind !== "user") return { ...contextMessage(event, event.data) }  // 降级为 context
return { kind: "user" /* 画成对话气泡 */ }
```

也就是说，注入消息只要来源不是 `user`，就会变成内部 `context`，**功能正常但在聊天里完全看不见**。
本项目第一版就栽在这里：模型收到了、行为也对，屏幕上却什么都没有。现在固定用
`source: { kind: 'user' }`（不带 `form`），并把文案前缀写成 `[自动 · 分步暂停 · …]`，避免被误认成用户输入。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上实测可用（`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 声明）；
- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；
- 主机侧唯一依赖是 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（peer，由宿主解析）；
- 浏览器半边只 `require('react')`，**不依赖** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（该包不随 SDK 发布）。

## 已知限制

- **按 step 计，不按「思考 token」计**：一次 step = 一次模型请求＋它的工具调用。每轮第 1 步不汇报。
- **不是硬中断**：不会取消正在执行的工具，只在步骤边界插入。
- **汇报会留在会话历史里**：它是真正的 user 消息，会进上下文、会被导出。想少留痕就把 N 调大。
- **子 agent 也汇报**：每个子 agent 独立计数，长任务里可能比你预期更频繁。
- **不强制模型必须照做**：提示词是请求，极端情况下模型可能只回一句就继续。
- **主机半边不会拖垮 profile**：加载失败只会被跳过并留一条 `dsh: warning`（用三个故意弄坏的插件实测过）。
- **客户端半边是唯一风险面**：`lib/client.js` 若加载失败，桌面窗口可能整个起不来。只想要主机逻辑的话，
  删掉 `lib/client.js`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`，再清掉 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.client` 与对应的
  `exports` 即可，行为完全不受影响。

## 开发

```bash
npm install          # 只装 @deepseek-ai/schemastery（dev）
npm test             # 10 组断言
```

测试覆盖：只在第 N 步注入、同步去重、消息形状与冻结、原批次不被改写、`reject`/`aborted` 透传、
每轮配额重置、占位符渲染、`enabled: false` 不注入但保留注册、schema 默认值、运行中改配置立即生效。

```
dsh-step-pause/
├── package.json          # exports / files / dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client / dsh.compatibility
├── cordis.patch.yml      # loader 补丁（一条 insert）
├── lib/index.js          # 主机逻辑：Config + agent/pre-step 监听
├── lib/client.js         # 浏览器半边：注册「设置 → 插件 → 本插件 → 配置」页
├── locale/{zh,en}.json   # 插件页标题与描述
├── icon.svg              # 插件页图标
├── test/index.test.mjs   # 离线行为测试
└── docs/config-page.png  # 实测截图
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 只插一条 loader 条目；**不要**把它手写进 profile 的 loader 列表，
否则会撞 `duplicate loader entry id`。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头显示 Cline / ClinePass 额度、Credits 余额与 token 消耗（支持多账号切换）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cline-quota

> 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的会话页头显示 **Cline / ClinePass 订阅额度**、**Credits 余额**与 **ClinePass token 消耗**，支持**多账号**切换。
>
> A DSH plugin that shows your Cline / ClinePass subscription quota, credits and ClinePass token consumption in the session header — with multi-account switching.

零依赖、无构建步骤：host 半边只用 Node 内置模块，client 半边是手写的模块包（只用到 shell 提供的 `react`）。

## 功能

- **页头 chip**：显示最紧的 5 小时窗口占用百分比，按压力变色（>70% 琥珀、>90% 红）；悬停给出三个窗口 + 余额的一行摘要。多账号时摘要里会带上账号名。
- **弹层**：
  - 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月三个窗口的进度条、百分比与重置倒计时
  - `Credits（按量付费）` 余额
  - `Token 消耗` 块：日期区间选择（含 `24h` / `7 天` / `14 天` / `30 天` 预设）、合计 token 与金额、每日（或每周、24h 下按小时）柱状图、以及**可点选的模型列表** —— 点某个模型即可只看它的消耗
- **多账号**：在面板里直接粘贴 API key 添加账号，`⇄` 循环切换，`✕` 移除
- 只统计 `aiModelTypeName === 'cline-pass'` 的用量，与上面的 ClinePass 额度口径一致

## 安装

已同时发布到 **npm** 与 **GitHub**，两个源内容逐字节一致：

| 来源 | 安装标识 |
|---|---|
| npm（推荐） | `dsh-cline-quota` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cline-quota |
| GitHub | `github:Wei-l-w/dsh-cline-quota` |

### 1) 插件面板（推荐）

DSH 侧边栏 →「插件」→「添加插件」，填 `dsh-cline-quota`（或 `github:Wei-l-w/dsh-cline-quota`；也可以填本地目录 / `.tgz` 的**绝对路径**）。

### 2) 命令行

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-cline-quota
```

> 桌面版占用的 `desktop` profile 不能从命令行管理（会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）；这种情况请用上面的插件面板。

装完刷新窗口即可看到 chip；**host 半边**的改动需要重启 DSH 才会重新加载。

## 配置账号

默认使用凭据引用 `CLINE_API_KEY`（就是 profile 里 `cline` provider 用的那个名字）。

**方式一：面板里粘贴**（推荐）

账号行右侧 `＋` → 粘贴 key → 保存。插件会先用 `GET /users/me` 验证这个 key，通过后：

- key 写进 DSH 凭据库 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（与现有 `CLINE_API_KEY` 同一处，权限 600）
- 插件自己的名单文件 `$DSH_HOME/cline-quota.accounts.json` 只记 `label` + 引用名，**不存明文**
- 面板自动切到这个新账号；账号名默认取该账号邮箱

**方式二：配置文件**

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- id: cline-quota
  config:
    accounts:
      - label: 主号
        keyRef: CLINE_API_KEY
      - label: 备号
        keyRef: CLINE_API_KEY_2
```

key 本体放 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 下，或 `$DSH_HOME/.env`（只读回退层）。配置改完不必重启（loader 会带新配置重新 `apply`）。

## 关于金额（重要）

- 三个百分比是 **Cline API 给的**（按参考价加权的配额占用），不是本地用 token 数算的。
- `Token 消耗` 块里的 `$` 是 Cline 按它的**参考价**折算的用量价值，**不是账单**：ClinePass 是订阅制，参考价不等于实付金额。
- 对 `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，Cline 的参考价 = DeepSeek 官方**高峰**价（输入 $0.30 / 缓存命中 $0.006 / 输出 $1.20 每百万 token）；DeepSeek 空闲价是它的一半。
- `0.1.0` 把 Cline 的 usage/caps 金额字段当成了 micro-USD，金额会放大 100 倍；`0.2.0` 已修正（usage/caps 按 `1e-8` 折算，`Credits` 余额仍是 micro-USD）。

## 安全与隐私

- API key 只在 host 进程里按**引用名**解析；浏览器只会拿到额度数字、账号邮箱与引用名。
- 面板里粘贴的 key 只在本机 loopback 的 POST body 里出现一次：**不回显、不写日志**（诊断日志只记方法、是否强制刷新、账号名、区间、UA、origin）。
- 插件不做任何遥测；host 进程只直连 `https://api.cline.bot`。
- 路由在本机 loopback 上**无鉴权**（与 DSH 中其它精确路由一致）：同机进程可以读到额度数字与邮箱，但读不到 key。

## 兼容性

- 需要带 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 座位的 DSH；在 **0.2.1-rc.2**（桌面版内置版本）上验证。
- Node >= 22。

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm test
```

`test/accounts.test.mjs` 是离线 harness：把真实的 host 半边挂到假 ctx 与假 Cline API 上，覆盖账号选择、粘贴 key（验证 → 写凭据库 → 名单文件）、重复 key/重名、删除、以及金额单位换算。`test/range-presets.test.mjs` 校验区间预设的高亮映射与"数据已过期"判定（24h / 7 / 14 / 30 天与自定义区间）。

### 发版（维护者）

```bash
npm version patch          # 或 minor / major：改版本号并打 tag
npm publish --access public
git push --follow-tags
```

> 品牌新包的**首次**发布会先进入 npm 的 staged 队列：registry 上先出现 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版，实测约一分钟后自动上架。若被拦下需要 maintainer 用 2FA 批准 —— npm ≥ 11.15 用 `npm stage list` / `npm stage approve <stage-id>`，或在 npmjs.com 的 **Staged Packages** 页点 Approve。

## 卸载

插件面板里卸载，或：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-cline-quota
```

## 声明

与 Cline / ClinePass 官方无隶属关系；"Cline" 仅用于说明本插件查询的服务。

## License

MIT © Wei-l-w

plugins.description: dsh-reel-studio: turn a DSH plugin repo into a promo video and promo image (local Remotion studio + host tools).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reel-studio

**Turn a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin repo into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image — locally, with Remotion.**

Package: `dsh-reel-studio` · Repo: `Eileenes/dsh-reel`  
English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Status: working prototype. The Remotion pipeline and both outputs are tested end-to-end. The DSH host package (`dsh.bundle`) is scaffolded, but has **not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile**.

## Demo

- [Watch the 32.5s promo video](docs/demo.mp4)
- [Promo image (2160×2880 PNG)](docs/promo.png)
- [Video poster](docs/poster.png)

![Better Sidebar promo image](docs/promo.png)

The demo targets [omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) (MIT). It is an unofficial sample used to test the *repo → promo material* workflow. Screenshots are from that public repo; task/side-chat visuals are synthetic mocks.

## What it makes

### Promo video

- 32.5s / 1920×1080 / 30fps / H.264 + AAC stereo.
- Seven scenes: hook → problem → solution → four features → how to use → proof/install/address → outro.
- Cut to a 120 BPM generated soundtrack; scene cuts and card entrances land on half-beats.
- Real DSH screenshots + DSH-style wordmark / palette / cartoon whale mascot.
- Covers: what it is, what it solves, how to use it, install command, repo address, numbers.

### Promo image

- 1080×1440 layout, rendered at 2× = 2160×2880 PNG.
- DSH visual language: `deepseek HARNESS` wordmark, DSH blue/mint, grid, real DSH screenshots, cartoon whale with speech bubble.
- Information blocks: what it is / what it solves / how to use / install command / address / stats.
- No private data: task and side-chat panels are synthetic mocks, not captured conversations.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22+
- pnpm
- Chrome or Chromium (Remotion renders with it). Set `CHROME_PATH` if it is not in a standard location.
- Python 3 only if you want to regenerate the BGM.

## Quick start

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Eileenes/dsh-reel.git
cd dsh-reel/studio
pnpm install
cd ..

# optional; the CLI also checks common macOS/Windows/Linux paths
export CHROME_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"

# video + poster + promo image
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode both

# only one output
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode video
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode image
```

Outputs go to `studio/out/`:

- `<slug>-demo.mp4`
- `<slug>-poster.png`
- `<slug>-promo.png` (2×)

Options: `--poster-frame 825`, `--dry-run` (write props only).

## Case format

A case is one JSON file. It is deliberately explicit so a human or an agent can review every claim before rendering.

```json
{
  "plugin": {
    "name": "Better Sidebar",
    "handle": "dsh-better-sidebar",
    "version": "0.28.0",
    "repo": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar",
    "install": "dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar",
    "downloads": 46445,
    "stars": 4297,
    "tagline": "一个侧边栏，装下整个开发工作台"
  },
  "features": [
    {"no": "01", "title": "File tree + editor", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/files-tree.png", "accent": "#4d6bfe"},
    {"no": "02", "title": "Git", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/changes-tree.png", "accent": "#5ef2c2"},
    {"no": "03", "title": "Tasks", "desc": "...", "mock": "tasks", "accent": "#ffb86b"},
    {"no": "04", "title": "Side chat", "desc": "...", "mock": "sidechat", "accent": "#8ea6ff"}
  ],
  "promo": {
    "problem": "One session, five surfaces, half a screen.",
    "what": "Native right sidebar + a bottom workbench.",
    "how": ["Install", "Open the right sidebar", "Use the tabs"],
    "address": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar"
  }
}
```

Images are resolved from `studio/public/`. Use your own clean screenshots or the built-in synthetic mocks.

## Use as a DSH plugin

The repo includes a host-side plugin package:

- `reel_scan` — read a local plugin package/README/screenshot directory.
- `reel_plan` — turn a brief into a deterministic storyboard.
- `reel_render` — render `mode=video|image|both` locally.

Install into a scratch profile (not yet validated against a real DSH build). Once published to npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add dsh-reel-studio
```

Until then, install straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add github:Eileenes/dsh-reel
```

## Limitations / roadmap

- The case is authored by hand for now; `reel_scan`/`reel_plan` automation is next.
- Only 16:9 video and 3:4 image; 9:16 vertical and 1:1 square are TODO.
- No voiceover yet; the video uses generated music + captions.
- Host package needs real-profile validation, HMR/dispose checks, and a slimmer publish shape before it is market-ready.
- Do not render third-party screenshots without permission; prefer synthetic mocks or your own UI.

## Publishing / plugin market

See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for the npm + DSH market checklist.

## Disclaimer

This is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. “DeepSeek”, “DSH”, and related marks belong to their owners; they are used here only to describe compatibility. The cartoon whale is an original illustration, not the official logo. Demo screenshots come from the MIT-licensed better-sidebar repo; task/side-chat panels are synthetic.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH plugin: create a workspace by name in the browser instead of opening an OS folder chooser on the host
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quick-workspace

Make the sidebar's **Add workspace** button work when you are driving the DeepSeek
Harness web UI from somewhere other than the host machine.

## What was wrong

The stock flow opens an **OS folder chooser on the host**. `dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`
resolves the `native` backend whenever the bind host is `127.0.0.1` on macOS, and that
backend is a renderless `osascript "choose folder with prompt …"` call: it puts a Finder
dialog on the host's screen and renders **nothing** in the browser.

So from a remote browser (Tailscale, LAN, a phone) the button looks completely dead, and
it gets worse than dead — while the hidden dialog is open, `WorkspacePickFlow` holds
`directoryBusy`, and `shortcutControls.add` is a no-op whenever that flag is set. Every
later click is then silently ignored, with no error and nothing on screen.

## What this plugin does

It occupies both directory-flow holes — the sidebar header button and the composer's
*Choose workspace* — with a **name dialog**:

1. you type a name,
2. the dialog shows the exact path it is about to create,
3. DSH makes the folder and registers it as a workspace, then opens it.

New folders land **beside the deployment's default workspace**, which on this machine is
`~/Documents/deepseek-harness/` for a workspace at `~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace`.

It registers at `priority: -100`, which is the documented way to *shadow* a single-kind
slot occupant: `SlotCore.register` sorts entries by ascending priority and the lowest
renders, so this takes the seat instead of throwing `already has a registration` against
the native/browse picker.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/plugins/dsh-quick-workspace
```

Then restart `dsh web` so the host half re-imports (see below).

## Two things that bite when editing this

- **`lib/index.js` needs a `dsh web` restart.** The client half hot-reloads; the host half
  does not. After editing `lib/index.js`, `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-quick-workspace`
  and re-add, or restart the server.
- **`process.cwd()` is `/`.** `dsh web` runs as a launchd KeepAlive agent, so the working
  directory is the filesystem root, and `mkdir("/<name>")` fails with a bare `EACCES` that
  tells the user nothing. The parent comes from `workspaceRegistry` instead, and the root
  is refused outright with `quick-workspace/no-parent`.

## Wire shapes worth remembering

- `ctx.connection.rpc.call("/api", "ns/method", payload)` resolves to the
  `{ok, value | error}` envelope. Reading `.path` straight off it yields `undefined`
  **without throwing** — always unwrap.
- The Gateway derives its argument descriptor from the Host method's signature. A
  parameterless `describe()` must be sent `{args: {}}`; `{args: {request: {}}}` is rejected
  with `gateway/arguments-invalid`.

## Uninstall

`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-quick-workspace` (or disable it on the Plugins page),
then restart `dsh web`. The stock folder picker comes back.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地软件逆向与反编译技能（APK/JAR/.NET/原生 PE/固件），带工具探测、授权门禁、证据分级
plugins.readme_text:
# Reverse Engineering Toolkit — a switchable DSH skill plugin

A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** that registers one model-invocable skill,
`reverse-engineering`, in the profile-global skill layer. Disable the plugin row
(or the whole bundle) in Plugin Manager and the skill disappears from the session
catalog; enable it again and it comes back.

Repository: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill>
Index: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-plugins>
Companion plugin: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-install-profiler> (installation
profiling, dynamic probing, and the handoff brief that feeds this skill).

Inspired by the viral "REA — Reverse Engineer Anything" project
(<https://github.com/morluto/rea>), which popularized agent-driven reverse
engineering after adding Android/APK analysis in October 2026. This plugin is an
independent implementation: it ships instructions plus a local toolchain probe,
not REA's engine or MCP server.

## What it does

- Adds a `skill` catalog entry that the agent loads on demand, then follows to
  classify an artifact, probe installed decompilers, work an authorized target,
  and report evidence-backed findings.
- Bundles `scripts/probe-tools.ps1` (32 tools across Android/Java/.NET/native/
  support, PATH + common install dirs + Android SDK, ~1.5 s, read-only).
- Enforces a blocking authorization gate and an explicit refusal list before any
  tool call, and degrades honestly when a decompiler is missing.

## Install (once)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill.git C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

Then, from a DSH session with Full access or approval:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

The install is a **link**: keep that directory in place, or the plugin breaks.
To update later: `git pull` in that directory, then toggle the row off and on
(the `SKILL.md` body is re-read on activation).

Then confirm the row is active with `plugin_manager list_plugins` (look for
`reverse-skill`) or approval-free `cordis_inspect_query` on the `Config`
provider filtered by `@local/dsh-reverse-skill`.

## On / off

- `plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=reverse-skill enabled=false` — unregisters
  the skill; the next turn receives a replacement catalog without it.
- `enabled=true` — re-registers it (the SKILL.md body is re-read on activation,
  so content edits take effect after a toggle, without restarting DSH).
- `action=remove_bundle target=@local/dsh-reverse-skill` — uninstalls completely.

## Layout

```
package.json              bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch)
cordis.patch.yml          inserts row id `reverse-skill`
index.js                  registers the skill via ctx.skills.register()
locale/en.json, zh.json   Plugin Manager title/description
icon.svg                  original icon
skills/reverse-engineering/
  SKILL.md                the instructions the model loads
  references/tool-recipes.md
scripts/probe-tools.ps1   read-only toolchain probe
```

## Safety

The skill refuses DRM/licence/anti-cheat bypass, credential theft, unauthorized
targets, live-service interaction, and redistribution of decompiled material. It
never executes a target on the host; dynamic analysis is limited to a disposable
device/VM the user authorizes. Decompiling a client never reveals server-side
logic — the skill states that limit instead of overselling.

plugins.description: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop UI: search the conversation and the right panel, highlight matches, and jump between results. As-is / best-effort.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-anywhere

为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness  提供 `Ctrl+F` 式查找：在**当前对话**和**右侧面板**中搜索已渲染文本，高亮全部匹配，并在结果间循环定位。

包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-find-anywhere`，版本 `0.1.0`，纯浏览器实现。

> **发布状态：as-is / best-effort。** 本仓库按现状发布，不承诺持续维护、不承诺跟进上游变更，也不承诺及时响应 issue。详见 [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md)。

## 为什么值得用：右侧面板内容也能搜

右侧面板常驻文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等信息。多数查找只覆盖对话正文；本插件把**右侧面板当前激活页里已渲染的文字**纳入同一套查找条：

- 面板打开时，右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮，点击即可查找面板内容。
- `Ctrl+Shift+F` 直接进入右侧面板范围。
- 查找条停靠在面板内容区顶部，避开标签栏和文件路径行，并随面板展开/全屏/切换标签重新定位。
- 对话和右侧面板共享高亮、计数、上一个/下一个循环；范围随时切换。

查找条只读取 DOM 文本，不修改面板结构，也不发送内容到网络。

## 使用

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开查找条；焦点在右侧面板时搜索面板，否则搜索对话 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 打开右侧面板范围 |
| 对话标题栏的 🔍 / 右侧面板右下角的 🔍 | 鼠标打开对应范围 |
| 输入文字 | 实时高亮全部匹配，计数显示 `当前/总数` |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl+G` | 下一个匹配（循环） |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` / `Ctrl+Shift+G` | 上一个匹配（循环） |
| 计数旁 `↑` / `↓` | 上一个 / 下一个 |
| 查找条左侧的范围切换 | 在对话与右侧面板之间切换 |
| `Esc` | 关闭并清除高亮 |

### 范围规则

- **对话**：搜索当前对话列里已渲染的文字（用户消息、助手回复、工具卡片、命令输出等）；输入框和编辑器被排除，草稿不会产生假匹配。
- **右侧面板**：搜索当前激活页里已渲染的文字（文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等）；面板标签栏、按钮和工具栏文字被排除。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 面板关闭时，面板入口自动隐藏；面板重新打开或切换标签后，查找条会重新定位。

## 设计取舍

- **不包裹 `<mark>`**：对话 DOM 归 React 所有，流式输出时持续重渲染。插件使用 CSS Custom Highlight API 在 Range 上绘制高亮，不插入节点，不破坏 reconciliation。
- **MutationObserver 跟随流式输出**：对话继续输出或历史分页载入时防抖重算匹配；按“文本节点 + 偏移”保持当前匹配，不会跳到另一个位置。
- **纯 DOM 检索**：不依赖会话数据结构，因此工具卡片、命令输出、折叠内容中已渲染的部分都能被找到；尚未进入 DOM 的虚拟化历史不在范围内。
- **极简外观**：单行 38px 浮条，沿用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，自动适配明暗主题；无结果时计数与边框变红并轻微抖动（尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`）。
- **右侧面板入口**：面板打开时右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮；面板关闭时自动隐藏，不占用面板标签栏的槽位。

## 能力边界

- 只匹配渲染后的纯文本：不做正则、不折叠变音符号、不跨文本节点匹配（被样式拆开的短语可能匹配不到）。
- 依赖 CSS Custom Highlight API（当前 Chromium / Electron 均支持）；不支持时仍能计数和滚动定位，但没有高亮底色。
- 虚拟化或懒加载的历史若尚未进入 DOM，需要先滚动加载后再搜索。
- 右侧面板的**浏览器页签**如果是跨域 iframe，父页面无法读取其内部文字；**终端页签**（canvas/xterm）也没有可检索的 DOM 文本。这两类内容搜不到是预期行为。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 若 `Ctrl+Shift+F` 被其他功能占用，用右侧面板右下角的 🔍，或把焦点放进右侧面板后按 `Ctrl+F`。

## 安装与构建

运行时需要支持客户端插件的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。`lib/` 是注入器实际加载的产物；`src/` 是源码。

```bash
# 仓库是源码形态；先生成运行产物
bash scripts/build.sh
```

若你的环境装有 `dsh-super-injector`，可以把仓库目录注入：

```text
dev_inject_plugin /absolute/path/to/dsh-find-anywhere
```

卸载：

```text
dev_uninject_plugin dsh-find-anywhere
```

也可以直接使用发布包 `dsh-external-dsh-find-anywhere-0.1.0.tgz`。该 tgz 包含 `lib/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、`README.md`、`LICENSE` 和 `MAINTENANCE.md`；具体安装方式取决于你的 DSH 版本。

注意：源码仓库的 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `lib/`，所以 GitHub 上的仓库默认是源码形态；需要预构建产物时请使用 tgz，或本地运行构建脚本。

## 隐私与安全

- 不读取会话数据库，不调用后端接口，不发送任何内容到网络。
- 插件在 DSH Web UI 页面内运行，会读取当前页面已渲染的 DOM 文本。安装前请自行审阅源码。
- 查找高亮使用浏览器原生 Highlight API，不向页面插入额外节点。

## 验证状态

本次发布整理只修改了 `package.json` 元数据与文档，没有重新运行 GUI 验证。功能描述基于现有实现，按 as-is 提供；如果上游 UI 结构变化导致失效，本仓库不承诺修复。

## 文件

- `src/client/index.js` — 全部浏览器逻辑与 UI（ModuleLoader bundle 源文件）
- `src/index.js` — Host 注册壳（无 host 行为）
- `scripts/build.mjs` — 无编译依赖的构建（语法校验 + 复制）
- `lib/` — 注入器实际加载的产物（由 `src/` 生成）
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` — 插件管理页的标题/描述元数据
- `icon.svg` — 原创图标（对话气泡 + 放大镜）
- `LICENSE` — MIT
- `MAINTENANCE.md` — 维护状态与自维护指引

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dsh-find-anywhere contributors

plugins.description: Transparent draggable performance HUD for DeepSeek Harness - CPU, GPU and memory usage plus CPU/GPU temperatures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud

A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness web UI:
**CPU / GPU / memory usage**, plus the **CPU package temperature** when the
optional helper is installed.

![dsh-perf-hud floating over the Harness window](docs/preview.png)

## Highlights

- **Fully transparent** — no card background, no border. Just three rows of text
  floating over the interface, with a soft halo so it stays readable on any
  content.
- **Drag it anywhere.** On release it anchors to the nearest window corner, so
  maximising, restoring or resizing the window keeps it exactly where you put
  it. Double-click resets to the top-right, arrow keys nudge it, and the chevron
  that appears on hover collapses it to a single row.
- **Load-aware colours** — usage turns amber at 70% and red at 90%; temperature
  at 78 °C / 88 °C. Stale readings dim the whole card instead of flashing a fake
  zero.
- **Theme-aware** — only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so it follows light, dark and
  any custom theme.
- **Local only** — the metrics route answers loopback, same-origin requests and
  returns 403 for everything else. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The GPU counters, the PowerShell worker and the temperature
  helper are Windows-specific.
- DeepSeek Harness with the web UI.

## Install

From the Plugins page (install from GitHub or a local folder), or:

```sh
dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
```

Then reload the interface once.

## What it reads

| Metric | Source |
| --- | --- |
| CPU usage | `node:os` CPU-time deltas, once a second |
| Memory usage | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` — same definition as Task Manager's "In use" |
| GPU usage | Windows `GPU Engine` performance counters, busiest engine (what Task Manager reports) |
| CPU temperature | optional helper — LibreHardwareMonitor's `CPU Package` sensor |
| GPU temperature | only when the GPU exposes a temperature sensor; most integrated GPUs do not, so the cell shows `—` |

## Temperatures (optional)

The plugin works out of the box; without the helper both temperature cells show
`—`. For the real CPU package temperature, run **once** (it asks for
administrator rights):

```
helper\setup.cmd
```

That script downloads and sets up:

- **LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6** (portable, library only) — reads the sensors;
- **PawnIO 2.2.0**, a signed kernel driver — required to read MSRs while Windows
  "Memory integrity" (HVCI) stays enabled, so you do **not** have to weaken that
  setting;
- **`sensor-helper.ps1`**, which writes one small JSON file about every 0.4 s;
- a scheduled task **`DSH Perf Sensor`** (at logon, highest privileges, no
  window), so it never asks again.

Files go to `D:\DSHTools` when that drive exists, otherwise
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSHTools`. The plugin reads either location.

Measured overhead on an 8-core laptop: **0.08 % of one core and ~87 MB of RAM**
for the helper — it is mostly waiting on the driver, not burning CPU.

Remove it again with:

```
helper\uninstall.ps1              # stops the task, uninstalls the driver
helper\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveFiles # ...and deletes the helper files
```

## Limitations

- Windows only.
- GPU temperatures need a dedicated sensor; Intel integrated GPUs do not expose
  one, and the CPU package temperature is the closest reference (same die).
- The card floats **inside the Harness window**, not as a separate
  always-on-top desktop window.

## 中文说明

DeepSeek Harness 界面里的一块完全透明的性能读数：CPU / GPU / 内存占用率，加上
CPU 封装温度。没有底色和边框，只有三行文字浮在界面上。

- **拖动**卡片任意位置移动，松手后吸附到最近的窗口角，窗口最大化 / 还原 / 改变
  大小都保持位置；**双击**回到右上角，方向键微调，悬停右侧箭头可收起成一行。
- 占用率 ≥70% 变琥珀、≥90% 变红；温度 ≥78 °C / ≥88 °C 同理；读数过期整卡变暗。
- 安装：插件页面安装本仓库，或 `dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud`。
- 温度需要可选助手：管理员运行一次 `helper\setup.cmd`（会安装 LibreHardwareMonitor
  与 PawnIO 签名驱动，并注册开机自启任务）。不需要时用 `helper\uninstall.ps1` 移除。
- 没有温度助手时温度一栏显示 `—`；Intel 核显本身没有独立温度传感器，同样显示 `—`。
- 仅支持 Windows；悬浮窗在 Harness 窗口内部，不是独立的桌面置顶窗口。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Ephemeral /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: full conversation context, no tools, never written to history.
plugins.readme_text:
# @andrewhmir/dsh-btw — ephemeral `/btw` side questions for the DSH Web GUI

An **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds one gesture to the Web GUI composer:

```
/btw how does the compaction checkpoint interact with the surface?
```

The answer streams into an overlay over the app. Dismissing it leaves **no
trace** in the session: the question and answer are never appended to the
transcript, never rendered as chat rows, and never become part of what the model
sees on the next turn.

It is the inverse of a subagent: a subagent gets the full tool surface and an
empty context; `/btw` gets the full conversation context and no tools.

## What `/btw` does

| property | behavior |
|---|---|
| invocation | `/btw <question>` typed in the composer, mid-session; also selectable from the `/` menu |
| context | the full committed conversation of the current session |
| tools | none — the request carries no tool schemas and no tool history |
| answer | streamed into an overlay over the app frame |
| dismissal | Space, Enter, or Escape (also the close button / backdrop) |
| persistence | none — the exchange never enters session history |
| concurrency | works while the main turn is streaming and never interrupts it |
| shape | single-shot; no follow-up turns |
| model | the session's routed provider/model/reasoning effort |
| cost | one tool-less call whose message prefix is the parent request's prefix, so the provider's prompt cache is reused |

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with the Web GUI (`dsh web`).
- Node.js 22 or newer only for the verification scripts; the plugin itself runs
  inside the harness process.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and one
client+host plugin row (`id: btw`). Install it into the profile you run, then
restart `dsh web`.

### From a plugin market

Enable DSH's custom plugin market, add a community index that lists this package
(the repository carries the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic so indexes can discover
it), and install `@andrewhmir/dsh-btw` from the Discover tab.

### With the agent

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw@0.1.2
```

### From a local checkout

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-btw
```

### After installing

**Restart `dsh web`.** The running process holds its pre-install module graph;
a restart loads the new host half. Then confirm the composition:

```
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Expected: exit code 0 and a row `id: btw` / `name: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw` with no
`not found`, `unknown key`, or `cannot resolve` lines.

After editing only `client.js`, the harness's client HMR picks the rebuilt file
up on save; host-half edits need a restart.

## How it works

- `ui-commands` claims slash commands that exist in the session's **host**
  command catalog. `/btw` deliberately does not register such a command: a host
  command's result is durably logged (`command/run` / `command/done`) and would
  enter the session history.
- Instead, the plugin's **client half** registers its own `'/'` input-trigger
  source. During composer adjudication it claims `/btw <question>` before any
  host command runs, opens the overlay, and calls the plugin's own loopback
  route `POST /btw/ask`.
- The **host half** resolves the live agent for the session, snapshots the exact
  model-visible history with `Session.deriveMessages()`, appends one frozen user
  message carrying the side question, and runs a single `ctx.llm.stream()` call
  with **no tools, no tool history, and no separate system prompt**. Because the
  message list is the parent request's prefix plus one trailing message, the
  provider's prompt cache is reused.
- The answer streams back as newline-delimited JSON, renders **Markdown** through
  the shell's shared `MarkdownText` component (plain-text fallback if an older
  shell does not seed it), and is shown in a `shell.overlay` panel.
  Space/Enter/Escape abort the request and close it.
- A snapshot taken mid-turn can end with an assistant tool call whose
  `tool/result` is not committed yet. The host trims that trailing unresolved
  step before replaying the history, so `/btw` answers with the conversation as
  of the last completed tool step instead of the provider rejecting the request
  ("tool calls need immediate results").
- Nothing in this path calls `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox — that is what makes the exchange ephemeral.

## Private by design

The ephemerality is a contract, not a rendering choice:

- the question and answer are never written to the session log, so they are not
  in the transcript, the token meter's session history, or any export;
- the host route never touches `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox;
- the only durable effect is provider billing for one call.

It is verified against real session logs: `test/e2e/ephemerality-check.mjs`
decodes every `session.v*.jsonl.zstd` in a test home and fails if the question or
any part of the answer appears in a persisted event. A control run proves the
scanner detects text that *is* legitimately persisted. Results for both supported
harness versions are recorded in [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Configure

The plugin row accepts two optional values; both have safe defaults and are read
without a Config schema:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: btw
      name: '@andrewhmir/dsh-btw'
      config:
        maxTokens: 1200    # completion cap for one side answer (default 1200)
        timeoutMs: 120000  # hard deadline for one side call (default 120000)
```

Questions are capped at 4000 characters; the request body is capped at 32 KiB.

## Known limitations

- **In-flight partial assistant text is not included.** The snapshot reads the
  committed session surface; while the main turn is streaming, the current
  assistant message is not committed yet. `/btw` sees the conversation as of the
  last committed event.
- **Not visible in session-log cost dashboards.** Ephemeral calls leave no
  session-log trace; provider billing is the source of truth for them.
- **Web GUI only.** The host route is generic, but the invocation and overlay are
  client-side Web features.
- **English overlay copy.** Display metadata ships in English and Chinese;
  in-overlay strings are English in this version.
- **A future host `btw` command would shadow this plugin.** The host catalog is
  adjudicated before the plugin's source; if a future harness version ships a
  host command with the same name, `/btw` would execute that command instead.
- **Single-shot.** There is no follow-up turn inside the overlay.

## Compatibility

`engines.dsh` declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2`. Both tags were verified on a clean-room
install containing only the official bundles plus this plugin:

| Harness | Result |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) | overlay + streamed answer, uppercase `/BTW`, Markdown, Escape/Space/Enter dismissal, warm cache |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`) | the above, plus mid-stream concurrency (4/4 answers during a tool call) and strict ephemerality |

See [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the measurements and the
exact commands.

## Verify

From this directory:

```
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
node tools/build-client.mjs --check
node --check client.js
```

The clean-room and browser harness lives in `test/e2e/` and is documented there.
It is not shipped in the published package:

- `clean-room.ps1` builds a fresh DSH home with only the official bundles plus
  this plugin, seeds the workspace state, composes, boots, and prints the URL;
- `first-run.mjs` dismisses the first-run preview notice and proves the composer
  accepts text;
- `cdp-e2e.mjs` drives the real GUI over the DevTools protocol (`probe`, `full`,
  `dismiss-keys`, `mid-stream`);
- `ephemerality-check.mjs` asserts that no exchange reached a session log.

## Development

```
node tools/build-client.mjs         # regenerate client.js from src/client/*.mjs
node tools/build-client.mjs --check # fail when client.js is stale
node --

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-fee

按**工作区**维度监控 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）token 消耗与人民币费用的 Web 插件。

- 顶部状态栏药丸 + 图形化查询面板（浏览器侧）
- 模型工具 `workspace_fee` 与斜杠命令 `/fee`（会话内直接查询，不产生模型消息）
- 每工作区**日预警线 / 总预警线**（ok / warn / over 三档）
- 按**北京日**汇总的账单（工作区 × 日期），并落盘为按日 JSONL
- 统计口径四档：近 **7 / 30 / 90 天**，以及**全量**（`days=all`）
- 宿主侧引擎零第三方运行时依赖（只用 `node:` 内置模块）
- 只读本地会话日志，**不联网**、不上传任何数据

> 费用数字是**按会话日志自算的估算值**（按 DeepSeek 官方刊例价），**不是账单实付额**，
> 也不抓取官方价格。币种默认 CNY，可配置。

---

## 1. 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.1.2-rc.1`（`engines.dsh`）；开发与实测基于 **0.2.0-rc.2**（桌面版 + `dsh web`） |
| 宿主形态 | **DSH Web 宿主**：桌面应用（Electron）或命令行 `dsh web`。两者使用同一套 Web 前端 |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（需要 `node:zlib` 的 zstd 支持） |
| 运行时依赖 | 无（插件本体只用 `node:` 内置模块；浏览器侧只依赖宿主注入的 React） |

**边界**：本插件是 DSH 的 cordis 插件 + DSH Web 客户端 bundle，**只能在 DSH 官方宿主里运行**。
非 DSH 平台、以及没有 `webServer` 服务的 profile（如 `headless` / `sdk`）不会加载它。

---

## 2. 安装到 profile

插件以 `link:` 形式装进 DSH profile，使 profile 的依赖列表与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都能解析到
`dsh-workspace-fee`。安装后**必须重启宿主**并刷新页面。

### 2.1 Windows：一键安装（推荐）

```powershell
# 1) 先干跑，确认它打算做什么（不写任何东西）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-profile.ps1 -WhatIf

# 2) 真正安装（默认 web + desktop 两个 profile）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-profile.ps1

# 找不到桌面版安装目录时显式指定（含 "DeepSeek Harness.exe" 的目录）
powershell ... -File scripts\install-profile.ps1 -DesktopAppDir "D:\path\to\deepseek-harness-desktop"

# 只装某一个 profile / 卸载
powershell ... -File scripts\install-profile.ps1 -Profile web
powershell ... -File scripts\install-profile.ps1 -Uninstall
```

说明：

- **装哪个 profile 取决于你用哪种宿主**：桌面应用使用 `desktop` profile（由应用独占，只有桌面运行时
  自带的 CLI 能管理）；`dsh web` 使用 `web` profile。
- `dsh` 通常不在 `PATH` 上。脚本会优先使用桌面安装自带的
  `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`；也可以显式传 `-DshExe <路径>`。
- PowerShell 执行策略拒绝运行 `.ps1` 时，使用上面的 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`。
- 脚本是纯 ASCII，这是刻意的：Windows PowerShell 5.1 会把无 BOM 的 UTF-8 `.ps1` 按 ANSI/GBK 解码。
- 安装步骤会写入插件目录之外（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`）。目标目录无写权限时会失败（如 `EPERM`），
  这不是脚本缺陷；脚本会打印可直接复制的命令。
- pnpm 会清掉 profile 里未被 `package.json` 声明的包，属预期行为。

### 2.2 手动安装（任意有 DSH CLI 的平台）

```bash
# web profile（dsh 在 PATH 上时）
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/this/repo

# desktop profile：必须用桌面运行时自带的 CLI 入口（应用独占该 profile）
# Windows 示例（PowerShell）：
# & "D:\...\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals `
#   "D:\...\deepseek-harness-desktop\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js" `
#   plugin --profile desktop add link:<仓库绝对路径>
```

`dsh plugin` 是对 pnpm 的薄转发：在 profile 目录里跑 `pnpm add`，随后把 `dsh.profile.bundles`
与已安装状态对齐（声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 的依赖会加入 bundle 层栈）。本插件的补丁只
insert 一行，不改任何既有行的 config。

> macOS / Linux 上同样使用 `dsh plugin ... add link:<绝对路径>`（这是 pnpm 转发，本身跨平台）。
> **但本项目目前只在 Windows 上实测过**，macOS / Linux 未验证；桌面版 profile 的 CLI 入口路径
> 也因安装方式而异。详见 §8。

### 2.3 重启并刷新

浏览器侧是在宿主启动时加载的，不重启不会出现：

- **桌面版**：退出并重新打开 DeepSeek Harness，然后刷新页面。
- **`dsh web`**：停掉服务再启动，然后打开对应地址并刷新。

重启后会话头右侧应出现状态栏药丸：**工作区名 + 今日花费 + 预警色点**；点开后是近 N 天总花费、
按工作区横条，以及四个默认折叠区「按日账单 / Token 明细 / 预警线 / 价格设置」。

宿主侧是否可用，可离线核对（GUI 需要登录，直接请求 HTTP 往往返回 401，见 §7.3）：

```bash
node scripts/report.mjs --json     # 不经 HTTP，直接看引擎账目
```

---

## 3. 配置

优先级（高 → 低）：`settings 命名空间 dsh-workspace-fee 的用户段` → `<dataDir>/config.json`
→ 插件行 `config` → 内置默认。

### 3.1 插件行 config（`cordis.patch.yml`）

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `home` | string | DSH home（优先于 `$DSH_HOME`） |
| `sessionsRoot` | string | 会话日志根（优先于 `$DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_SESSIONS`） |
| `dataDir` | string | 账本数据目录（优先于 `$DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_DATA`） |
| `pricing` | object | 价格表覆盖（`families`/`models`/`peakWindows`/`versions`/…） |
| `alerts` | object | 预警线覆盖（`{defaultLimit, warnRatio, workspaces}`） |
| `persistCache` | boolean | 是否把解析缓存写盘（默认 `true`） |
| `flushSeconds` | number | 缓存落盘间隔秒数（默认 `60`，`0` = 不定时） |

### 3.2 环境变量

| 变量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `DSH_HOME` | DSH home；`sessionsRoot` 默认 `$DSH_HOME/sessions`，`dataDir` 默认 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-fee`，`usageDir` 默认 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage` |
| `DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_SESSIONS` | 覆盖会话日志根（测试/演示时把数据指到别处） |
| `DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_DATA` | 覆盖账本数据目录（解析缓存 + `config.json`） |
| `DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_USAGE` | 覆盖按日 JSONL 账单目录 |
| `DSH_WORKSPACE_FEE_PROFILE` | 显式指定 profile 目录，供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 运行时解析 |
| `DSH_CORE_DIR` | 独立验证脚本查找 DSH 证据源码的根目录（默认不猜测） |

### 3.3 按日 JSONL 账单

每次 `GET /summary` 与 `POST /refresh` 都会把账单覆盖写到 `usageDir`：

- `<usageDir>/<工作区目录名>.jsonl`：每行 `{type:'workspace-day', date, cost, tokens, sessions, …}`
- `<usageDir>/summary.jsonl`：每行 `{type:'day', date, cost, tokens, …}`（全工作区按日合计）

格式逐字段见 [`docs/SPEC.md`](docs/SPEC.md) §2b。写失败只告警（`diagnostics.usageBill.error`），
不影响账目。

### 3.4 运行时改动（面板 / HTTP）

`GET/POST /api/dsh-workspace-fee/config`：改预警线、改价格表、追加价格版本、重置。
请求体与响应形状见 [`docs/SPEC.md`](docs/SPEC.md) §2/§3。

---

## 4. 口径（会直接影响费用数字）

- **统计窗口**：`GET /summary?days=N` 是滚动窗口（最近 N 个北京日，含今天），
  `window.from = 今天 −(N−1)`。`days=all` 是**全量口径**：从最早一条可定位日期的用量记录
  所在北京日起到今天；`days` 字段回显字符串 `"all"`。非法值（`0`/`-1`/`366`/`1.5`/`1e3`/`allx`）
  一律 **400** —— 「全量」是显式字面量，不是「非数字即全量」。
  - 边界：**无时间戳的用量记录不进任何窗口**，只计入 `workspaces[].lifetimeCost`；
    条数由 `diagnostics.undatedUsageRecords` 给出，不会静默少算。
- **数据源**：DSH 会话日志 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<编码工作目录>/<会话id>/session[.v<N>].jsonl.zstd`。
  DSH 会随格式升级改文件名（`session.jsonl.zstd` → `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` → `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` …）。
  插件**逐个会话目录取版本号最大的那个文件**，其余版本记入 `diagnostics.supersededSamples`。
  **不能把同目录的多个版本都读**：新版本是整篇重写，两个都读会把重叠记录算两遍。
  实际读到的版本分布见 `diagnostics.sessionFileVersions`。
- **计费**（契约 v1.1）：
  `cost = cacheReadTokens/1e6*hit + inputTokens/1e6*miss + outputTokens/1e6*out`。
  - `inputTokens` 是**互斥桶**（宿主源码：`inputTokens = prompt_tokens - cacheRead`），**不得**再减一次 `cacheRead`。
  - `reasoningTokens` **已包含在 `outputTokens` 内**，**不再相加**。
  - 两个对照开关：`pricing.inputIncludesCacheRead`（默认 `false`）、
    `pricing.reasoningIncludedInOutput`（默认 `true`）。
  - `scripts/probe.mjs` 会打印 A/B/C 三种算法的总额与差额百分比，让口径可被反证。
- **币种**：`pricing.currency = CNY | USD`（默认 `CNY`）。两套内置费率（每百万 tokens，空闲价）：
  `CNY` flash 0.02/1.0/4.0、pro 0.15/4.5/13.5；`USD` flash 0.003/0.15/0.6、pro 0.022/0.66/1.98。
  高峰 = 空闲 × 2。可用 `pricing.rates.<CUR>` 覆盖或新增币种。
- **时段**：一律**北京时间 UTC+8**。高峰 = 工作日（周一至周五）09:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00
  （**左闭右开**）；其余（含**周末全天**）为空闲。高峰价 = 空闲价 × 2（`peakMultiplier`）。
  按日也按北京日分桶，与宿主机器时区无关。
- **默认单价**（元 / 百万 tokens，空闲时段）：`flash` 档（`deepseek-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash`、
  `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`、`deepseek-chat`、`deepseek-reasoner`、未知模型回退）
  = 缓存命中 0.02 / 缓存未命中 1.0 / 输出 4.0；`pro` 档（`deepseek-v4-pro`）= 0.15 / 4.5 / 13.5。
  **价格来源日期 2026-09-10 12:00；请以官方页面为准。** 价格表可完全覆盖，不硬编码。
- **记账边界**：计**任何**带 `data.usage` 的记录；`(type,seq)` 去重 + 逐字去重；
  **只取 `data.usage`，绝不累加 `data.stream[].chunk.usage`**（两处基本同值，同时累加会让账单翻倍）。
- **处理不到的输入显式登记**：见 `/summary` 的 `gaps[]` 与 `docs/SPEC.md` §6。

---

## 5. 脚本与自测

```bash
# 人类可读自证报告（帧统计、去重一致性、双计虚增、价格、按日账单、缺口）
node scripts/probe.mjs --days=365 --out=reports/probe-report.md

# 机器可读报告
node scripts/report.mjs --json  --out=reports/report.json
node scripts/report.mjs --raw                 # 只输出 GET /summary 的响应体
node scripts/report.mjs --raw --days=all      # 全量口径
node scripts/report.mjs --segments            # 按段核对单价
node scripts/report.mjs --md

# 宿主侧测试
node --test --test-isolation=none tests/pricing.test.mjs tests/session-log.test.mjs \
  tests/ledger.test.mjs tests/routes.test.mjs tests/plugin.test.mjs
node --test --test-isolation=none "tests/*.test.mjs"
node tests/client-bundle.test.mjs              # 浏览器侧

# 独立验证装置（19 项；见下方说明）
node tests/verify-independent/run-all.mjs
```

`npm test`、`npm run test:all`、`npm run test:client`、`npm run test:verify` 是等价入口。

**测试不需要真实会话日志**：fixtures 全部由
[`tests/verify-independent/harness/make-synthetic-corpus.mjs`](tests/verify-independent/harness/make-synthetic-corpus.mjs)
用固定种子生成，不含任何真实数据。

**独立验证的当前状态（如实说明）**：`run-all.mjs` 共 19 项，其中 **17 项通过、2 项失败（exit 1）**：

1. `refute-buckets` 的 2 条断言依赖 DSH 上游源码作为可核验证据；找不到源码时**如实地失败**
   —— 用 `DSH_CORE_DIR` 指向包含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
   的 `node_modules` 后重跑。
2. `caliber-immutability` 是**已登记缺陷 F-12**（`pricing.reasoningIncludedInOutput` 是全局开关，
   翻转会回溯改写历史口径的解读），脚本故意 `exit 1` 以保持可见。本版**未修**。

> **受限环境注意**：若运行环境禁止子进程 `piped s

plugins.description: Governed documentation tree for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, with AI-assisted /docs-organize workflow.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-doc-tree

**A governed documentation tree for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.**

在 DSH 原生右侧栏里按分层浏览文档、展开 `records/{lifecycle}/{class}`、全文搜索、同栏阅读 Markdown，并通过 `/docs-organize` 让模型完成语义分层、机械体检与人工审批。

还带一个 **Files.md 风格** 的阅读模式：暖色主题、双文档对照、`Ctrl/Cmd+K` 快速切换，以及行内/块级 LaTeX 公式渲染。

![双栏布局](docs/screenshots/split.png)

![阅读器](docs/screenshots/reader.png)

![Files.md 风格 + LaTeX](docs/screenshots/filesmd-theme.png)

![LaTeX 公式（默认主题）](docs/screenshots/latex.png)

![双文档对照](docs/screenshots/filesmd-pair.png)

![快速切换](docs/screenshots/filesmd-quick.png)

## 特性

- **策展分层**：文档地图 / 口径契约 / 记录层 / 子系统参考 / 运维手册 / 术语 / 其他；组头显示篇数，可折叠。
- **记录层语义**：`records/{proposed|implemented|rejected|archived}/{class}` 自动成树；生命周期色点 + class 标签；阅读时把首部 `Status:` 行提到标题下；记录层内可按 lifecycle / class 筛选。
- **根目录扫描**：雷达按钮扫描工作区（`docs`/`documentation`/`wiki`，以及项目目录下的 `docs`），候选带篇数，点选切换。
- **搜索**：路径/文件名 + 正文全文（后台建立内存索引，命中带上下文片段与高亮）。
- **阅读**：复用宿主 `MarkdownText`，相对 `.md` 链接在 tab 内跳转，`大纲` 按 h1–h4 导航。
- **配置驱动**：工作区根 `.dsh-doc-tree.json` 定义 `root` / `groups` / `records.statuses`；没有配置时用内置默认分层。
- **AI 分层**：`/docs-organize` 让模型 scan → 读入口 → lint → dry-run → 用 `ask_user_question` 批量审批 → 写配置。
- **布局**：右栏 ≥700px 自动双栏（列表 + 阅读区），更窄时单栏下钻；排版对齐 DSH 文档预览的阅读体验。
- **Files.md 风格**：顶栏调色板按钮切换暖色主题（大标题、暖灰背景、蓝链接、左侧蓝条引用）。
- **双文档对照**：阅读器「对照」按钮选择第二篇文档；宽屏显示「列表 + 两篇」，窄屏自动隐藏列表、两篇平分。
- **快速切换**：`Ctrl/Cmd+K` 打开命令面板，按路径过滤，↑/↓ 选择，Enter 打开。
- **LaTeX 公式**：`$...$` 行内、`$$...$$` 块级；矩阵、分式、对齐、表格混排；复用宿主 KaTeX，不额外打包。

![全文搜索](docs/screenshots/search.png)

![记录筛选](docs/screenshots/filter.png)

## 独立性

本插件**不依赖** `dsh-docs-panel` 或 `dsh-better-sidebar`。它只使用 DSH 官方扩展点：

- 右侧栏 tab：`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register` + `sidebar.right.pane.tab` slot
- 数据：`workspaceFiles` Remote（只读）
- Markdown：baseline `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MarkdownText` / `MarkdownDelegateProvider`
- Host 工具：`ctx.tools.register` + `ctx.commands.register` + `ctx.fs`

## 键盘与交互

| 操作 | 快捷键 / 入口 |
|---|---|
| 快速切换文档 | `Ctrl/Cmd+K` |
| 关闭快速切换 / 大纲 | `Esc` |
| 切换 Files.md 风格 | 顶栏调色板按钮 |
| 双文档对照 | 阅读器「对照」→ 选择第二篇 |
| 取消对照 | 右侧阅读器「取消」 |
| 切换原始结构 | 顶栏 `<>` |
| 重新扫描 | 顶栏 `⟳` |
| 扫描文档根 | 顶栏雷达按钮 |

## 公式

公式由宿主 `MarkdownText` 的 KaTeX 渲染，插件不引入额外依赖：

```markdown
行内：$E = mc^2$

$$
\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial \theta}
= \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}(\hat{y}_i - y_i)^2
$$
```

块级公式建议 `$$` 独占一行，前后留空行。示例见 [examples/docs/formulas.md](examples/docs/formulas.md)；把根指向 `examples/docs` 即可在插件里看到公式、矩阵、表格与对照效果。

## 安装

要求 DSH `0.2.1-rc.1+`（开发验证于 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。

```bash
# 从 GitHub 安装（dsh plugin 会把参数转发给 pnpm）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Meowrium/dsh-doc-tree

# 或本地开发
git clone https://github.com/Meowrium/dsh-doc-tree
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-doc-tree
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`，浏览器硬刷新（Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R）。右侧栏「＋」→「文档树」。

开发期可用 `dsh-super-injector` 热装配，免重启：

```text
dev_install_package /path/to/dsh-doc-tree
```

## 快速开始

1. 打开右侧栏「＋」→「文档树」。
2. 首次打开会自动扫描候选根目录；也可点顶部雷达按钮重扫，点候选路径后「保存」。
3. 点右上角 `<>` 可在「策展分层」和「原始目录结构」之间切换；`⟳` 重新扫描。
4. 点击文档在右侧阅读；`大纲` 打开标题导航，`×` 关闭当前文档。
5. 想看公式/对照示例：把根目录填成 `<workspace>/dsh-doc-tree/examples/docs`。

## 配置

配置写在**工作区根** `.dsh-doc-tree.json`（不是文档目录内）：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "root": "docs",
  "generatedAt": "2026-10-19T00:00:00.000Z",
  "generatedBy": "docs-organize",
  "groups": [
    { "id": "map", "title": "文档地图", "hint": "L2", "match": ["README.md", "AGENTS.md"] },
    { "id": "contracts", "title": "口径契约", "hint": "L4", "prefix": "contracts/", "match": ["contracts/**"] },
    { "id": "records", "title": "记录层", "hint": "L5", "prefix": "records/", "match": ["records/**"], "records": true },
    { "id": "development", "title": "子系统参考", "hint": "L2", "prefix": "development/", "match": ["development/**"] },
    { "id": "other", "title": "其他", "match": ["**"] }
  ],
  "records": {
    "dir": "records",
    "lifecycles": ["proposed", "implemented", "rejected", "archived"],
    "statuses": { "records/implemented/feature/x.md": "implemented" }
  }
}
```

- `match`：相对文档根的 glob，`*` 段内、`**` 跨段、`?` 单字符；按数组顺序匹配，建议最后一组放 catch-all。
- `prefix`：仅用于显示时剥离路径前缀。
- `records: true`：该组启用 lifecycle 色点与筛选。
- `records.statuses`：`includeStatus:true` 时生成的快照，读取正文时仍以文件为准。
- 根目录也支持工作区相对路径，如 `project/docs`。

## AI 分层：`/docs-organize`

```text
/docs-organize                 # 默认：scan + lint + dry-run + 人工审批
/docs-organize docs            # 指定工作区相对根
/docs-organize --report docs   # 只出报告：不提问、不写配置
```

默认流程：

1. `doc_tree_scan` 拿文件清单与候选根。
2. 阅读 `README.md` / `AGENTS.md` / 索引，判断分层语义（明确要求「不要按目录名硬套」）。
3. `doc_tree_lint` 做机械体检，把问题分成「必须人决定」和「仅报告」。
4. 设计 3–8 个分组 + 待决策清单（合并/归档/改名/状态冲突/断链），**先不写**。
5. `doc_tree_apply_plan(dryRun:true)` 拿覆盖校验与「旧配置 → 新配置」diff。
6. **必须调用 `ask_user_question`**（不是正文提问）批量审批，最多 3 问、固定 id：
   - `apply-plan`：应用 / 只看报告 / 调整后重试
   - `lint-decisions`：仅报告 / 允许处理可机械项 / 逐项说明
   - `status-snapshot`：写入 / 不写
7. 选「应用」才 `dryRun:false` 落盘；选「只看报告」输出清单；选「调整」改完重跑 dryRun（≤2 轮）。
8. `ask_user_question` 不可用/报错时**禁止写配置**，输出结构化「待审批清单」。

**边界**：合并/删除/移动文档不在本命令范围内；lint 问题默认只报告，除非用户明确同意处理「可机械项」。

### 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `doc_tree_scan {root?, includeStatus?}` | 扫描 Markdown、返回候选根与文件清单（标题 / Status / 字节） |
| `doc_tree_lint {root?, includeLinks?, maxIssues?}` | 只读体检：重复内容/标题、断链、孤儿、入口可达性、Status 冲突、未归类、空文档 |
| `doc_tree_read_plan {}` | 读当前 `.dsh-doc-tree.json`（没有返回 `null`） |
| `doc_tree_apply_plan {root, groups, records?, includeStatus?, dryRun?}` | 校验覆盖；`dryRun:true` 只返回 diff 不写，false/省略才写配置 |

### 人工审批

- **过程内（默认）**：模型在写配置前必须调用 DSH 自带的 `ask_user_question`，一次批量问 1–3 个问题，拿到答案后才执行；问题渲染成交互卡片。
- **结束统一审批**：`--report` 或用户选「只看报告」时不写配置，只输出分组表、diff、lint issues、建议动作与未决问题；人工确认后再跑一次普通 `/docs-organize`。

必须人工确认：覆盖已有配置、处理 lint 的重复/断链/孤儿/状态冲突、写入 `records.statuses`、任何文档内容改动（本命令不做）。

## 结构

```
dsh-doc-tree/
├─ package.json       # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client(platform:web)
├─ cordis.patch.yml   # bundle 挂载行
├─ lib/index.js       # host：doc_tree_* 工具 + /docs-organize 命令
├─ lib/client.js      # client：tab 类型注册 + 扫描/配置 + 树 + 阅读器
├─ examples/docs/     # 公式 / 对照示例文档
└─ docs/screenshots/  # README 截图
```

## 扩展点

- 类型：`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind, priority:'extension', keepMounted, title, guide })`
- 正文：`ctx.slots.register({ name:'sidebar.right.pane.tab', key:id, inject:(sessionId)=>({...}) }, Body)`
- 数据：`ctx.remote.workspaceFiles.list(sessionId, workspaceRel, signal)` 与 `read(sessionId, absolutePath, { offset, limit }, signal)`
- Markdown：`MarkdownText` + `MarkdownDelegateProvider`（baseline 模块，无需 `dsh.client.external`）

## 已知限制

- 自动扫描是有界启发式（约 64 个一级目录 × 16 个子目录），超大仓库建议直接 `/docs-organize <root>` 或手填 root。
- 没有配置且内置分组一个都匹配不上时，所有文件落到「其他」；此时可用「原始结构」或生成配置。
- `groups` 只做 glob 机械匹配；语义分层由模型在 `/docs-organize` 中判断。
- 正文索引在打开 tab 后后台建立，不做增量更新；外部改动后点 `⟳` 重建。
- 单文件读取上限 5000 行（`workspaceFiles.read` 分页参数）。
- 记录状态徽标取自路径 lifecycle；文件内 `Status:` 在阅读时显示。
- 未做虚拟滚动；上千篇文档建议加。
- 窄屏对照模式会隐藏左侧文档列表，点右侧「取消」回到列表。
- 公式渲染依赖宿主 `MarkdownText` 的 KaTeX（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 已内置）；未加载 KaTeX 时公式会退化为文本。
- Files.md 风格是视觉/交互移植，不包含它的编辑器、chat、sync 或文件写入能力。

## 开发与验证

```bash
node --check lib/client.js
node --check lib/index.js
```

已验证：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 右侧栏注册、124 篇扫描、记录层 80 篇展开、跨文档链接、全文搜索、记录筛选、dry-run diff、lint（真实文档 124 篇 / 0 error）、行内/块级 LaTeX、矩阵、双文档对照、`Ctrl/Cmd+K`。

## 致谢

- UI 布局与阅读排版参考了 [mlosun/dsh-docs-panel](https://github.com/mlosun/dsh-docs-panel)（MIT）。
- Files.md 风格参考了 [zakirullin/files.md](https://github.com/zakirullin/files.md)（MIT）；本插件只移植视觉/交互，未引入其代码。
- 右侧栏扩展点与 Markdown 渲染来自 [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的公开包。
