plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-hud

> **English summary** — A session-status desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
> A small animated pet sits in the bottom-right corner; clicking it opens a bubble with three live
> counts: **running** sessions, **completed-but-unread** sessions, and sessions **waiting for your
> choice** (approval / plan review / question). Clicking a count jumps to that session; clicking the
> same row repeatedly cycles through the sessions in that group.
> Zero npm dependencies, no host-side behaviour: everything is one self-contained client bundle
> (`lib/client.js`, pet animations inlined as base64). Build with `node tools/build.mjs`.
> Third-party content and licensing: see [`NOTICE.md`](./NOTICE.md). MIT.

DSH 会话状态挂件：右下角一只安静的宠物角标，单击展开气泡，实时显示你要的三个数字 ——

```
🌊 3 个在跑
✅ 1 个没看          ← 后台跑完、你还没打开过的
⚠️ 2 个等你选 (1 确认 · 1 提问)   ← 需要你手动做选项选择的
```

单击任一数字行 → 直接跳进对应会话；同类多个会话时**连续单击依次轮换**（右下角会提示 `2/3，再点下一个`）。

---

## 一、数据从哪来（全部是 DSH 原生服务，事件驱动、零轮询）

| 数字 | 来源 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| **进行中** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` **＋** `sessions.list.projectionsBySession` | 会话自己 `running === true`，**或**它名下还有 running 的**直接**子代理（`runningChildCount > 0`） |
| **完成未读** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `completionUnread === true`（**只**看主会话；子代理跑完不算） |
| **待你选择** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `pendingInteraction !== undefined`，**或**它名下**直接**子代理的 `pendingInteraction`（v0.6.0，**与侧栏有意分叉**，见 §1.2） |

`sessionStatus.getSnapshot()` 返回 `Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>`，
这是 DSH 0.2.0 的**统一会话状态面**（取代了旧的 pendingInteractions），实现在官方包
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session`（源码注释原文：*"Root source combining running,
pending-interaction, and completion-reminder facts"*）。

`pendingInteraction.kind` 的三分类（口径与 `dsh-activity-pane` 一致）：

| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `approval` | 待确认授权 |
| `plan-review` | 待审查计划 |
| `question` | 待回答问题 |

其余服务：`sessions.list`（会话行，用于标题与排序）、`workspaces.list`（归档过滤）、
`uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`（跳转）。

**统计口径**：只算主会话 —— 排除 `origin === "subagent"`（子代理）、`blank`（空白会话）、
已归档会话。与官方侧栏及活动面板一致。

**「进行中」是聚合口径**（v0.4.0 修，之前只数主会话自己的 `running`，于是主智能体空闲、
子代理还在跑时侧栏转圈而桌宠报 0）。官方侧栏 `lib/.../Rows.js` 的表达式是：

```js
// runningChildCount(list, parentId, statuses)
list.projectionsBySession[parentId]?.values.subagentCatalog
  ?.reduce((n, child) => n + ((statuses.get(child.id)?.running ?? list.byId[child.id]?.running) === true ? 1 : 0), 0) ?? 0
// sessionStatuses(): node.running === true 或 runningSubagentCount > 0 → ongoing（转圈）
```

本插件用 `runningChildCount()`（`src/widget.js`）实现同一表达式，只数**直接**子级
（孙辈算在它自己的父会话上，而那个父会话不是侧栏的行 —— 与侧栏严格对齐）。
拿不到 `projectionsBySession` 或形状异常时返回 0，退化为原行为，不抛异常。

> `completionUnread` 的语义（v0.5.0 从 asar 逐行查清，官方实现）：
> ```js
> // 471629
> isMain(id) { return (this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[id]?.retainedBy.mainView ?? 0) > 0 }
> // 718647  source:"mainView" 只在 uiWorkspace.openSession 里 retain
> const reference = this.sessions.retain(target, { source: "mainView" })
> // 471603-471609
> observeRunning(sessionId, running) {
>   const previous = this.running.get(sessionId)
>   const beforeBaseline = this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().phase === "pending"
>   this.running.set(sessionId, running)
>   if (running) this.completionUnread.delete(sessionId)
>   else if ((previous === true || previous === void 0 && beforeBaseline) && !this.isMain(sessionId)) this.completionUnread.add(sessionId)
>   this.publishStatus()
> }
> // 471620  reconcileStatus 只清除 isMain 的那一个
> for (const id of present) if (this.isMain(id)) this.completionUnread.delete(id)
> ```
> **`isMain` 不是「`origin === 'main'`」，而是「你当前打开的那一个会话」**（`mainView`
> 引用同一时刻只属于一个会话）。所以：
> - 你在会话 X 里，会话 Y 跑完 → **Y 置位** → 侧栏 Y 显示 `status.completed`「已完成」
>   （718135 / 719101，字典 721643），桌宠「完成未读」+1 ✅
> - 你正开着 Y、Y 跑完 → **不置位**（你已经在看了）
> - Y 重新跑起来 / 从列表消失 → 清除
>
> 这条曾被怀疑是「对主会话恒为 false 的死信号」，**已证伪**：它是有消费者的活信号。
> `tools/smoke.mjs` 有专门用例把它钉住（非主视图计数、主视图不计数）。
>
> ⚠️ **子代理的 `completionUnread` 谁都不显示**：子代理不是侧栏的行，
> `runningChildCount` 也只数 *running* 的子代理。所以「某个子代理跑完了」在官方 UI 里
> **没有任何信号**（侧栏状态字典 721633-721643 里没有这一项）。按用户裁决，桌宠**也不**
> 把它算进「完成未读」（规则②：只有**主代理**跑完才算），加了就违背裁决。
>
> 注意区分：子代理的 **pending**（在等你交互）**已经算了**（v0.6.0，规则③，见 §1.2）；
> 子代理的 **completion**（跑完了）**不算**（规则②）。

### 1.1 多状态组合矩阵（v0.5.0 穷举并钉住）

官方侧栏的状态词表就这 7 条（asar `721633-721643`）：
`status.running` 进行中 / `status.subagentsRunning` 子智能体运行中 / `status.idle` 空闲 /
`status.waitingApproval` 等待审批 / `status.planReview` 计划待审 / `status.waitingAnswer` 等待回答 /
`status.completed` 已完成 —— **没有「排队输入」之类的状态**（`QueueDock` 的 `queue.count` 属于对话区，418359）。

桌宠气泡是**三行独立计数**，不是 `if/else` 链，所以多状态共存时不丢信息。
唯一的 `if/else` 链是角标（只有一位数字），优先级与侧栏 `statuses[0]` 同序（719092-719108）。

| 组合 | 自身 running | 子代理 running | completionUnread | pendingInteraction | 进行中 | 完成未读 | 待选择 | 情绪 | 角标 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| S | — | ✅ | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| R+S | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | **1**（同一会话不重复计） | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| C | — | — | ✅ | — | 0 | 1 | 0 | celebrate | 1/done |
| P:approval | — | — | — | approval | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| **R+P:question** | ✅ | — | — | question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P:plan-review** | — | ✅ | — | plan-review | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P(child 持有)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | **子代理** question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **P(main)+P(child)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | main approval **+** child question | 1 | 0 | **2** | waiting | 2/wait |
| S+C | — | ✅ | ✅ | — | 1 | **1** | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| P+C | — | — | ✅ | approval | 0 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| R+P+C（官方不可能） | ✅ | — | ✅ | approval | 1 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| P:unknown-kind | — | — | — | 未知 | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| 孙辈在跑 | — | 孙辈 | — | — | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| 孙辈 pending（v0.6.0） | — | 孙辈 | — | 孙辈 question | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | **0** | dozing | 0/— |
| C(child 持有)（规则②） | — | — | **子代理** | — | 0 | **0**（子代理跑完不算） | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| Q:排队输入 | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| 混合 5 会话 | 3 个 | 1 个 | 1 个 | 2 个 | 3 | 1 | 2 | waiting | 2/wait |

### 1.2 规则③：子代理的待交互也算「等我选」（**有意与侧栏分叉**）

用户 2026-10-16 明确裁决：

> 我觉得桌宠显示的应该是，如果这个对话确实没进行完，**无论是主代理还是子代理，都应该挂着在跑**，
> 只有**主代理跑完了但我没点开**才会标明没看，**无论主代理或者子代理需要我交互选项卡来选择内容/一定需要我回复内容就算做等我选**

三条规则落地成：

| 数字 | 规则 | 与官方侧栏 |
|---|---|---|
| 进行中 | 主会话在跑 **OR** 直接子代理在跑 | **同口径**（`runningSubagentCount`） |
| 完成未读 | **只**看主会话自己的 `completionUnread`；子代理跑完**不算** | 同口径 |
| 待你选择 | 主会话自己的 pending **OR** 直接子代理的 pending | ⚠️ **有意分叉** |

**侧栏不显示子代理的 pending。** 依据是 `718128`：

```js
const pendingInteraction = visiblePendingKind(status?.pendingInteraction?.kind)  // 只看会话自己
```

而桌宠 v0.6.0 起把**直接子代理**的 pending 也算进来。分叉是**明示的取舍**，不是失手 ——
因为「子代理卡在问你问题」这件事，侧栏只会显示「N 个子智能体运行中」（`status.subagentsRunning`），
看不出它在等你。

**子代理的 pending 从哪读**（取证，全部 asar 行号）：

```js
// 336653  每个会话（含子代理会话）都有自己一个 scope，标签就是它的 session id
const { fiber, ctx } = createScope(this.rootCtx, id)      // ClientSessions.materializeScope(id)
// 336567  scopeOf 就是把那个标签读回来
scopeOf(ctx) { return scopeTagOf(ctx) }                    // import ... from "../scope.js"

// 386458  approval：登记在**请求方 agent 的会话**名下
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)              // owner = $on 监听器的 scoped ctx
const pending = new PendingApproval(sessionId, {...})      // 386326 sessionId / 386353 kind="approval"

// 715845  question：同一模式
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)
const card = cards.ensure(sessionId, request.questions, callId)   // 714228 PendingQuestion.sessionId
                                                                 // 714224 kind

// 471591-471596  公开 Map 按 interaction.sessionId 归档（**每个 sessionId 只留一个 pending**）
const precedence = domain.precedence(interaction)
if (previous === void 0 || precedence >= previous.precedence) next.set(interaction.sessionId, { interaction, precedence })

// 471631-471643  汇进同一张 uiSession.sessionStatus
const ids = new Set([
  ...Object.keys(this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId),   // ← 子代理行也在里面（336695-336741）
  ...this.running.keys(), ...this.pendingSnapshot.keys(), ...this.completionUnread
])
for (const id of ids) next.set(id, { running: ..., pendingInteraction: this.pendingSnapshot.get(id), completionUnread: ... })

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加自由分屏：可拖拽窗格，每个窗格渲染一个会话的完整对话。Free split screen for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-split

[**中文**](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一个自由分屏**——开一个分屏视图放在旁边，同时盯住两个、三个甚至四个会话；每个窗格渲染的是那个会话**真正的对话**，连输入框都能直接用。

![三个窗格](screenshots/split-panes.png)

## 功能

- **侧栏入口**：侧栏里的「分屏」按钮把分屏视图作为一个主面板打开。
- **自由布局**：向右/向下分屏；把一个窗格拖到另一个窗格上＝交换；拖到窗格边缘＝把窗格挪过去；拖分隔线改比例；**双击分隔线**横竖翻转并回到 50/50。
- **从各处填充窗格**：从左侧会话列表把一行拖进窗格、点行尾的「放入分屏窗格」按钮，或者用窗格右键菜单。
- **真对话**：每个窗格挂载官方的 `conversation.content` 槽位，流式输出、工具调用、附件、输入框的行为与正常视图完全一致。
- **未读点同步**：侧栏的未读指示同步到窗格标题上，一眼看出哪个窗格在说话。
- **导入运行中会话**：一次把正在跑的会话按窗格上限排进分屏，不会关闭任何会话。**定时任务工作区的会话会被跳过**（cwd 最后一段是 `cron-jobs`；`client.js` 里的 `SCHEDULED_WORKSPACE` 可改）。
- **布局持久化**：整棵窗格树（分栏、比例、分配）存在 `localStorage`，刷新后恢复。
- **中英双语界面**：插件自带中文与英文文案。
- **宿主侧零行为**：宿主那一半只负责声明客户端 bundle，不碰 Session 域。

![窗格右键菜单](screenshots/pane-menu.png)

## 安装

插件是一个带 loader patch（`cordis.patch.yml`）的 bundle，和普通 DSH 插件一样安装：

```bash
# 直接从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yuloop/dsh-web-split

# 或者从本地目录装
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-split
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后刷新页面，侧栏就会出现「分屏」入口。

> `cordis.patch.yml` 用包名 `dsh-web-split` 指向 `index.js`。如果你是手工把文件拷进本地插件目录（而不是用安装器），把 patch 里的 `name` 改成 `index.js` 的绝对路径——开发机上就是这么跑的。

## 已知限制（重要）

在**窗格里点击文件链接或图片**会弹错误框：

```
无法打开文件 / sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted
```

原因：文件链接是通过右侧栏的 `sidebarRight.require()` 打开的，而它只认「当前显示在会话列上的那个会话」。全局的 `main` 面板不带会话上下文，所以这个调用会抛错。窗格本身照常渲染、滚动、输入；**只有文件/图片预览受影响**——想看文件就点侧栏那个会话回到普通视图，再点链接。

这条限制也正是本版本采用「面板式」的原因：还有一个「浮层式」变体（把网格浮在会话列上，让右侧栏继续工作），它换掉了网格所在的位置，发布时还不稳定，因此**不包含在 1.0.0 里**。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Web，且带官方 UI 包（`dsh-client-ui-layout`、`-session`、`-conversation`、`dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-api-session-controller`）。
- 开发与验证用的是 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`。

## 目录结构

```
client.js          Web 端全部实现（面板、窗格树、拖放、i18n、CSS）
index.js           宿主侧：只声明 bundle，不注册别的
cordis.patch.yml   loader patch 片段（insert id: web-split）
package.json       manifest，含 dsh.client 声明
docs/DEVLOG.md     开发日志，逐日记录（中文）
screenshots/       README 用的截图
```

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Arknights PRTS Wiki lookup tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ark-wiki

为 DSH 提供一个模型可调用的工具 `ark_wiki_lookup`：查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》数据（干员及其技能/天赋/档案/密录、物品、关卡、剧情、干员出场表与「泰拉大典」世界观考据），返回结构化结果，由模型据此作答。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki)

> **非官方粉丝项目**：与 Hypergryph（鹰角网络）、《明日方舟》官方及 PRTS Wiki 均无隶属关系；所有游戏数据与 wiki 文本的版权归原权利方，本项目仅做实时查询与展示，仅供个人非商业用途。详见[免责声明](#免责声明与权限)。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 GitHub 源码安装（当前可用）

```bash
# 1. 装到目标 profile（把 web 换成 desktop / 你实际使用的 profile 名）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki
# 2. 把包名 "dsh-ark-wiki" 写进该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组
```

### 方式二：npm

包**尚未发布到 npm**（npm 2026 年起要求发布者使用安全密钥 / 2FA，见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) 的「已知阻塞」一节）。发布后改为：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ark-wiki
```

装完直接在对话里用自然语言提问，例如：

- 「阿米娅的属性、技能和天赋」
- 「至纯源石是干什么用的」
- 「1-7 的掉落和敌人」
- 「0-1 坍塌 行动前 有哪些台词」「12F 干员密录」
- 「克莱门莎最早在哪个剧情出场」（走干员出场表，返回按时间排序的完整登场列表）
- 「矿石病是什么」「维多利亚的首都」「整合运动」「泰拉年表」（走泰拉大典世界观检索）

## 安装（本地开发路径）

插件是标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）。已实测可用的挂载方式：

```powershell
# A. 在 DSH 会话里用 plugin_manager 工具（推荐，自动完成 link + bundles 注册）
#    action: install_bundle
#    target: C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
#    实测返回 {"stage":"enable","enabled":true,"changed":true,"application":"applied","warnings":[]}
#    并在 profile 里生成 node_modules\dsh-ark-wiki junction，
#    同时把 "dsh-ark-wiki" 追加进 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles。

# B. 命令行（real syntax，注意 --profile 是必需参数）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:\path\to\dsh-ark-wiki
# 等价于在 %DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop 里执行 pnpm add <该路径>；之后仍需把包名加进
# 该 profile package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组（或由 plugin_manager 代劳）。
```

**开发期热重载**：插件是 junction 链入的，改完 `lib/*.js` 后不必重启 DSH——在会话里对 loader entryId 执行一次 disable → enable 即可让宿主重新 import 模块（实测 `{"application":"applied","warnings":[]}`，随后 `Tool/listTools` 立即出现新 schema）：

```jsonc
// plugin_manager, action: set_plugin, target 用 entryId 而不是包名
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": false }
{ "action": "set_plugin", "target": "include:dsh-ark-wiki", "enabled": true }
```

注意：`set_plugin` 传包名 `dsh-ark-wiki` 会返回 `{"application":"failed","error":{"code":"unknown-plugin"}}`，必须用 `include:<包名>`（可从 `plugin_manager` list_plugins 里查，或读 profile 的 `node_modules/<包名>/cordis.patch.yml` 中的 `id`）。

它依赖宿主注入的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（peerDependencies，宿主自行解析，插件不打包它们）。

## 工具契约

```jsonc
// 参数
{ "query": "阿米娅", "category": "operator" }   // category 可选：operator | item | stage | story | world
```

`category` 省略时按查询词自动判定：含「泰拉大典 / 世界观 / 考据 / 年表 / 词库」时先查泰拉大典；含「行动前 / 行动后 / 密录 / 剧情 / 序曲 / 出场 / 戏份 / 登场」或 `/BEG`、`/END` 时先当剧情查；形如 `1-7`、`S4-7`、`CE-5` 的代号先当关卡查；其余先查物品（仅接受完全同名），再查干员，然后关卡、剧情，最后泰拉大典。

剧情类别同时接受剧情页标题（`0-1 坍塌 行动前`）、章节/活动名（`黑暗时代·上`）与**干员名 + 出场**（`克莱门莎 出场`）；章节名返回 `candidates`（最多 8 条），模型可据此再查具体标题；干员出场会返回该干员在主线/活动/密录里的完整登场表。

世界观类别（`world`）覆盖 PRTS「泰拉大典」命名空间（143 页：角色/地理/组织/百科/生物/道具/剧情/关卡/成就/集成战略等）与附表 `泰拉年表`、`泰拉词库`、`泰拉文字`：先按页面标题精确/前缀匹配，再退到「泰拉大典」命名空间全文检索，解析其中的 `{{角色考据}}`/`{{地理考据}}`/`{{组织考据}}`/`{{种族考据}}`/`{{百科词条}}` 块；`泰拉词库` 另做译名对照（中文/英文/日文）。

返回值是一个 canonical JSON envelope（`output.schema` 已声明，`additionalProperties: false`）：

| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `ok` / `not_found` / `error` |
| `category` | `operator` / `item` / `stage` / `story` / `world` / `unknown` |
| `query` | 原始查询词 |
| `matchedBy` | `exact` / `prefix` / `fuzzy` / `redirect` / `search` / `none` |
| `entry` | 命中条目的结构化数据（`type: 'json'` 节点，字段随类别而定） |
| `candidates` | 未命中时的近似条目建议（最多 8 条） |
| `message` | 给模型看的说明（模糊匹配、未找到、错误原因） |
| `source` | `{ endpoint, page }`，可回溯到 PRTS 页面 |

`render(args, value)` 把 envelope 渲染成 `[{ type: 'text', text }]` 的 Markdown 摘要；非精确命中会附「匹配说明」，末尾附 PRTS 来源链接。

`entry` 的主要字段（`entry.category` 表明类别，`entry.url` 指向 PRTS 页面）：

- `operator`：`name`、`aliases[]`（中/英/日其他名称）、`stars`、`profession`、`subProfession`、`position`、`tags[]`、`feature`、`nation`、`organization`、`team`、`race`、`sex`、`birthday`（如 `12月23日`）、`designer`、`painter`、`obtainMethod[]`、`releasedAt`、`id`、`index`、`page`
  - `skills[]`：`{ index, name, nameEn, nameJa, chargeType, triggerType, unlock, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ level, description, initialSp, spCost, duration }`（`level` 形如 `1级`…`7级`、`专1`…`专3`）
  - `talents[]`：`{ slot, name, levels[] }`，`levels[]` 为 `{ condition, effect, potentialEffect }`（`condition` 如 `精英2 X模组3级`，`potentialEffect` 为满潜时的效果）
  - `buildingSkills[]`：`{ name, phase, level }`（基建技能）
  - `profile`：体检档案，`{ gender, combatExperience, birthplace, birthday, race, height, infectionStatus, infected, physicalStrength, mobility, endurance, tactics, combatSkill, artsAdaptability, cellFusionRate, crystalDensity }`（缺失字段省略；六维为「优良/标准/普通…」评级文本）
  - `archives[]`：`{ title, condition, text }`（基础档案、综合体检测试、客观履历、临床诊断分析、晋升记录等；`？？？` 占位段被过滤）
  - `records[]`：`{ set, index, page, url }`（干员密录：密录集名、第几话、PRTS 页面；`page` 可直接用 `category: story` 查台词）
- `item`：`name`、`itemId`、`rarity`（0 起算）、`rarityStars`、`kind`（分类）、`description`、`usage`、`obtain`、`page`
- `stage`：`code`、`name`、`type`、`subtype`、`difficulty`、`sanityCost`、`region`、`unlock`、`recommendedLevel`、`squadLimit`、`initialCost`、`costLimit`、`lifePoints`、`enemyCount`、`mapSize`、`fastestClear`、`drillCost`、`description`、`firstClearDrops[]`、`normalDrops[]`、`extraMateriel[]`、`reward`、`terrain`、`note`、`challenge{}`、`enemies[]`、`id`（游戏内部关卡 ID）、`story{}`（`{ before, after, extra? }`，每项 `{ title, page, url }`）、`page`
- `story`：`title`、`storyType`（主线/活动/干员密录…）、`storyGroup`（章节目录标题）、`chapter`、`kind`（`主线剧情`/`活动剧情`/`特殊剧情`/`干员密录`）、`textPath`（剧本资源路径）、`characters[]`（登场角色前 20）、`lineCount`、`truncated`、`lines[]`（最多 60 条，`{ speaker, text }`，`speaker` 为 null 表示旁白）、`operator`（干员密录所属干员）、`page`
  - 干员出场（`kind: '干员出场'`，来自剧情类别）：`operator`、`profession`、`rarity`、`total`、`counts`（`{ main, event, memory }`）、`earliest`（最早登场 `{ title, page, group, kind, date }`，`date` 可能为 null）、`appearances[]`（最多 48 条，`{ title, page, url, column, group, kind, date }`，按开放时间 → 主线章节顺序排序）、`truncated`、`source`
- `world`：`section`（人物考据/地理/组织/百科事典/生态调查/商品目录/剧情分析/附表…）、`title`、`summary`（正文首段，约 900 字）、`infobox`（地理页信息框键值，如 `{ 首都: '伦蒂尼姆' }`）、`details`（`{ 英文名, 日文名, 成员, 主要种族, 登场 }` 等模板参数，按页面可得性出现）、`sections[]`（小标题，最多 14 个）、`related[]`（`{ section, name, page, url }`，正文里的 `{{泰拉大典|…}}` 内链）、`terms[]`（`泰拉词库` 命中时为 `{ zh, en, other, ja, yostar, section }`）、`page`

掉落项形如 `{ name, condition }`（`condition` 为「固定掉落」「三星获得」等，可能为 null）；敌人项形如 `{ name, count, level }`。

## 免责声明与权限

- **非官方**：本项目是第三方粉丝工具，与上海鹰角网络科技有限公司（Hypergryph）、《明日方舟》官方运营方以及 PRTS Wiki 维护团队均无任何隶属或授权关系。
- **版权**：干员资料、剧情台词、物品描述等文本在运行时从 PRTS Wiki 实时读取，其版权归原权利方所有。本项目不打包、不分发、不缓存到磁盘；仅将单次查询结果交给当前对话中的模型用于回答。
- **用途**：仅供个人学习、研究与非商业查询使用。请遵守 PRTS Wiki 的访问规则，不要用本插件做批量抓取或高频轮询（插件内部有 10 分钟内存缓存与 8–12 秒超时）。
- **权限范围**：只读。仅通过 HTTPS 访问 `prts.wiki` 的公开 `api.php`；不读取本地文件、不读取任何凭据或环境变量、不上传对话内容、无遥测、无需 API Key。网络请求可通过宿主的 `AbortSignal` 取消。
- **风险**：查询结果依赖 PRTS 的页面模板结构（详见[已知限制](#已知限制)），PRTS 改版时相应字段会降级为空而不是编造数据；模型回答前应核对返回的 `source` 链接。

## 数据来源

全部走 PRTS 官方接口 `https://prts.wiki/api.php`，没有第三方爬虫或缓存服务：

1. **干员**：`ark-info` 包（`getOperators({ extraFields })`）→ 内部使用 MediaWiki Cargo `chara` / `chara_extra_info` / `char_obtain` 三张表。干员列表在进程内缓存 10 分钟，并按 zh/en/ja 名称建索引。
2. **技能 / 天赋**：PRTS **没有**这两类数据的 Cargo 表（`action=cargotables` 只返回 `building_skill2`、`char_building_skill`、`char_memory`、`char_mod`、`chara`、`chara_data`、`item`、`loot` 等），所以改为解析干员页 wikitext：`{{技能|…}}`/`{{技能2|…}}` 每个模板块一个技能（模板名的数字后缀随技能而变，**不是**槽位号），`{{天赋列表3|…}}` 里的 `天赋N`/`天赋N效果`/`天赋N条件` 与 `潜能增强_天赋N*`。基建技能另外走 Cargo `char_building_skill`（按 `_pageName` 过滤）。页面结果按干员缓存 10 分钟；页面取不到时静默降级为「只有基础档案」，不影响其余字段。
3. **物品**：Cargo `item` 表（`where: name LIKE '%关键词%'`）拿 `itemId`/`rarity`/`description`，再取页面 `{{道具信息}}` 模板补 `用途`/`获得方式`/`分类`（补全失败不影响主结果）。
4. **关卡**：直接按标题取页面正文，解析 `{{普通关卡信息}}` / `{{剿灭关卡信息}}` / `{{突袭关卡信息}}` / `{{敌方情报}}`；标题不存在时用 `action=query&list=search` 找候选页再解析前 3 个。命中后还会用剧情索引补出关联的「行动前 / 行动后」剧情链接。
5. **剧情**：PRTS 同样**没有**剧情 Cargo 表，所以分两条腿：① `Template:剧情导航`（约 146 KB）按表格行解析出 1700+ 条剧情页链接与所属章节/类型，得到「标题 → 页面」索引；② `char_memory` Cargo 表提供干员密录的 `storySetName/storyIndex/storyTxt`（`storyTxt` 是页面指针）。命中后取剧情页 wikitext 里的 `{{剧情模拟器|…}}`，解析 `剧情类型`/`剧情分组`/`文本路径` 与 `文本数据` 演出脚本（`[name="杜宾"] 台词`、`[Character(...)]`、`[Dialog]` 等），台词截断到 60 条。两个索引各缓存 10 分钟。
6. **干员档案**：解析干员页的 `{{人员档案set|…}}`（体检档

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH session cleaner: a sidebar page listing session records and archive caches, with a restorable recycle bin and an in-use guard.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-janitor · DSH 会话清理

给 DSH 用的会话记录清理工具：**列表 → 勾选 → 移入回收站 → 可恢复 → 确认后彻底清空**。
删除永不直接抹掉，先移进 `~/.dsh/session-trash/<时间戳>/`，所以手滑也能救回来。

## 两种用法

### 一、独立版（立刻可用，不需要重启 DSH）

双击本目录里的 **`启动会话清理.cmd`**，浏览器会打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8788/dsh-session-janitor/`。
关掉那个最小化的黑窗口即停止服务。端口被占用时可手动跑：

```
node standalone.mjs --port 8899 --open
```

### 二、DSH 插件版（推荐 · 已安装）

**2026-10-18 09:3x 已装进 desktop 档案**（`dsh.profile.bundles` 共 12 项，依赖 `link:` 指向本目录）。
**重启 DSH 后生效**：左侧边栏出现 🧹「会话清理」图标，点开就是完整界面（独立页面，不占会话）。
也可以直接访问 `http://127.0.0.1:<DSH GUI 端口>/dsh-session-janitor/`（由 DSH 自己的 web 服务提供，与 GUI 同源）。

重新安装 / 装到别的档案：

```
node install-plugin.mjs            # 演练：只打印将要做什么
node install-plugin.mjs --apply    # 真装（会先备份 profile 的 package.json）
```

卸载：把 `dsh-session-janitor` 从 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉、
并执行 `pnpm remove dsh-session-janitor`（或直接用备份 `package.json.bak-<时间戳>` 覆盖回去），然后重启 DSH。

> 客户端半侧是**手写的 `lib/client.js`**（无构建步骤），走 `sidebar.panellist` + `main` 两个槽位；
> 宿主半侧 `lib/index.js` 注册同源 HTTP 路由。二者靠 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的宿主条目被发现。

## 界面能做什么

| 区块 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 会话记录 | 勾选 → 移入回收站；「只选 30 天前」一键勾选老会话；`全选 / 清空选择` |
| 归档缓存 | 清理 `session_projcache_archive_manager_v2` 里的历史归档条目 |
| 回收站 | 勾选 → 恢复到原位置；`彻底清空回收站`（不可恢复） |
| 顶部 | `刷新`、`打开回收站文件夹`、`打开会话目录`、`强制` 开关 |

- **使用中保护**：会话的“最后活动时间”取 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 的 mtime，
  最近 **10 分钟**内被写过的会话标黄，默认**服务端拒绝删除**（勾「强制」才放行）。
- **同时清理列表缓存**：删会话时会把 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  一起移进回收站，恢复时一并还原，避免出现“缓存有、正文没”的孤儿条目。
- **安全**：只监听 `127.0.0.1`；每个请求都校验 `Host` 必须是本机回环、
  `Origin` 必须同源、`Sec-Fetch-Site` 不能是 `cross-site`，否则 403。
  所有路径都做白名单校验（禁止 `..` 与目录穿越）。

## 目录与接口

被测数据的默认根目录是 `~/.dsh`（可用环境变量 `DSCC_ROOT` 覆盖，测试用）：

```
sessions/<项目>/<会话>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd                       会话正文
storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json              标题 / cwd / 轮数
storages/session_projcache_archive_manager_v2/sessions/*.json      已裁剪归档
session-trash/<时间戳>/manifest.json                               本工具的回收站（含还原路径）
```

HTTP 接口（插件版挂在 DSH 端口，独立版在 8788）：

```
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/            网页界面
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/ping    存活探测 + 数据根目录
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/list    会话 / 归档 / 回收站清单
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/trash   {items:[{kind:"session",project,id}|{kind:"archive",file}],force?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/restore {ids:["<桶>:<序号>"]}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/purge   {bucket?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/reveal  {what:"trash"|"sessions"}
```

## 开发 / 自测

```
node --check lib/store.js
node --check lib/index.js
```

`lib/store.js` 是纯文件系统逻辑（不依赖 DSH），用临时假目录即可全量回归；
`lib/index.js` 的路由可用假 `ctx` + 假 `req/res` 直接调 `apply(ctx)` 验证。

## 已知边界

- 插件版要 **重启 DSH** 才会挂上路由；独立版不需要。
- 「使用中」判定靠写入时间，不是文件锁：正在被写入的会话靠 10 分钟窗口 + 文件占用（rename 失败）双重保护。
- 只处理会话与归档缓存；**不动** `schedule.json`、`workspace.json`、用量账本等运行状态。

## 收录到插件市场（awesome-dsh-plugin）

本插件按市场规范投稿：**一个 YAML 条目文件**（`data/plugins/<owner>__dsh-session-janitor.yml`）
就是全部投稿内容，市场从 **GitHub 仓库**安装（npm 发布是可选的，只影响市场显示下载量）。

仓库侧要求（都已满足）：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`（`./cordis.patch.yml`）、仓库根有
`cordis.patch.yml`、仓库带 `dsh-plugin` topic、仓库创建满 1 天、代码真实可用。
投稿条目内容见 `market-entry.yml`（市场只收 GitHub 仓库，一个 YAML 文件就是全部投稿）。

## 作者 / 许可

- 作者：**dsh**
- 许可：MIT（见 `LICENSE`）

# DSH-TokenDashboard **Your local token usage, API calls, and cache activity in one dashboard.** A lightweight plugin for DeepSeek Harness. No build step. No runtime dependencies. No additional API key. [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Runtime dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime_dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg) ![Built for DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-4D6BFE.svg) [Features](#features) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [How counting works](#how-counting-works) · [FAQ](#faq)
_Preview uses sample data. The plugin follows your DSH theme._ ## Why DSH-TokenDashboard? See how much you use across sessions, which projects drive token consumption, and how often your input hits the cache. The dashboard reads existing session logs in your current DSH profile and presents the results inside the native sidebar. ## Features | Feature | What you get | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Usage at a glance | Total tokens, API calls, uncached input, output, cache reads, and cache hit rate | | Flexible summaries | Last 7, 30, or 90 days, or all time, with active session counts | | Activity calendar | 52 weeks of square, rounded cells; hover or focus for exact daily numbers | | Daily cache trends | Stacked input tokens: cache misses below cache hits, with a visible zero baseline | | Adjustable chart range | Zoom from 7 to 30 days; compact K/M/B axis labels | | Model and project breakdowns | Token rankings and API call counts by model/provider and working directory | | Native presentation | Light/dark themes, responsive layout, English and Simplified Chinese | | Refresh controls | Manual refresh or automatic refresh every 30 seconds; polling pauses while the page is hidden | ## Quick start ### 1. Install from npm Use the DSH CLI available in your installation: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @ningtian-byte/dsh-tokendashboard ``` Alternatively, install directly from GitHub: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` ### 2. Desktop or local installation For Desktop, use the CLI bundled with the Desktop application: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` Alternatively, download **Code → Download ZIP**, extract it, and install the directory containing `package.json` through the DSH plugin manager or CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "/absolute/path/to/DSH-TokenDashboard" ``` On Windows, paths such as `C:/plugins/DSH-TokenDashboard` work as well. Quote paths that contain spaces. If `dsh` is not on PATH, use its installed executable or command file. The source CLI may reject the Desktop profile; use the Desktop-bundled CLI for that profile. ### 3. Open the dashboard Restart DSH and select **Usage statistics** in the sidebar. Existing completed requests appear automatically; the plugin does not need to run a new model request. > **Compatibility:** Requires DSH with `sessionPersistence`, `connection`, slot, locale, and theme APIs. DSH plugin APIs may change between releases; check compatibility with your installed version. ## Using the dashboard - Select a summary range at the top. Summary metrics and rankings follow this range. - Hover over or keyboard-focus a calendar cell or daily bar for exact usage and API call counts. Press **Escape** to dismiss the tooltip. - Drag the trend slider to show the latest **7–30 days**. One month means a rolling 30-day window. - Calendar history and the trend window are independent of the summary range. Changing that range preserves the trend zoom. - Toggle automatic refresh at the bottom of the page. ## How counting works | Metric | Definition | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Total tokens | Provider-reported `totalTokens`, or uncached input + output + cache reads + cache writes when unavailable | | Input | Uncached input only; excludes cache reads and writes | | Output | Provider-reported output; reasoning tokens are not added a second time | | Cache hit rate | Cache reads ÷ (uncached input + cache reads + cache writes); `—` when the denominator is zero | | API calls | Settled `assistant/message` and `assistant/attempt` records, including settled failures and attempts without usage | | Daily bars | Input only: cache miss = uncached input + cache writes; cache hit = cache reads | | Sessions | Sessions with at least one settled request in the selected summary range | An in-progress request appears after settlement. Requests without usage increase the API call count but do not add estimated tokens. Repeated settlements for the same attempt are deduplicated; retry attempts count separately, and inherited fork records are excluded. Days follow the browser's IANA time zone. Calendar weeks start on Monday. Output contributes to total tokens and tooltip details, but is not stacked in the input-cache chart. ## Data and privacy The plugin reads local session logs through read-only handles. It does not modify logs, call model APIs, or upload usage data. Numeric summaries, model names, session IDs, and working directories are kept in memory for the dashboard; prompt and response content is not retained in that cache. Each changed session is read in full before its numeric summary is cached by persistence revision. Very large logs can make the first load or a refresh slower. Unreadable sessions produce a visible partial-statistics warning. This is a token accounting view, not a billing or network bandwidth meter. Provider billing may use different accounting rules. ## FAQ ### Why is the dashboard empty? It only sees the session data source available to the current DSH profile. Complete a request in that profile, then refresh. Requests that are still streaming have not settled yet. ### Why do token totals differ from the provider's bill? The dashboard uses usage reported in local logs and has no access to billing adjustments or external requests. It does not estimate missing usage or calculate monetary costs. ### Why doesn't the chart match the selected summary period? The activity calendar always covers 52 weeks. The daily chart has its own 7–30 day window and displays input tokens only. The summary range applies to the headline metrics and rankings. ### How do I update or uninstall it? Replace or reinstall the plugin files, then restart DSH. Remove or disable the plugin through the DSH plugin manager to uninstall it. Session logs remain unchanged. ## Project structure ```text token-monitor/ ├── client.js # Dashboard, chart interactions, styles, and UI dictionaries ├── index.js # Read-only route and session summary cache ├── usage.js # Request deduplication and token aggregation ├── cordis.patch.yml # DSH bundle registration ├── icon.svg # Sidebar/plugin icon ├── locale/ # Plugin metadata translations ├── docs/images/ # Light and dark README previews ├── RE

plugins.description: DSH 聊天内原生图解与练习 / native in-chat diagrams and quizzes for DeepSeek Harness：把 ```figure / ```tree / ```quiz 代码块渲染成随主题自适应的 HTML，不用图片也不用 Mermaid
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chat-figure

简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.2.0-blue?style=flat-square)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DSH%20Web-blue?style=flat-square)
![Bundle](https://img.shields.io/badge/bundle-35%20KB%20zero--deps-brightgreen?style=flat-square)

---

在 DSH 对话里画示意图、层级树和选择题。三种代码块会被渲染成真实 HTML：文字是真文字，可选中、可缩放、跟随明暗主题，选择题可以直接点着作答。零依赖，不联网，不调用模型。

## 功能

| 块 | 用途 | 产出 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `%%figure` | 流程、结构、对比 | 盒子、箭头、注释、标签、图注 |
| `%%tree` | 进程树、目录树、调用层级 | 缩进即层级，父节点加粗、叶子变淡 |
| `%%quiz` | 随堂测验 | 单选、提交判分、解析、进度、成绩页 |

## 效果

| 流程结构图 | 层级树 |
| --- | --- |
| ![结构图](docs/preview-light.png) | ![进程树](docs/preview-tree.png) |

| 选择题（一次一题） | 答完立即判分 |
| --- | --- |
| ![选择题](docs/preview-quiz-step.png) | ![判分](docs/preview-quiz-feedback.png) |

<details>
<summary>深色主题</summary>

![深色主题](docs/preview-dark.png)

</details>

## 用法

块的第一行是哨兵，决定渲染成什么；围栏语言写什么都行。

### `%%figure`

````markdown
```figure
%%figure
title: fork() 之后：一分为二
sub: 父子各有独立 PID，内存先共享同一批物理页
arrow: fork()
row
box gray: 父进程 Bash | PID 1000 · fork() 返回 1001
box blue: 子进程 Bash（副本） | PID 1001 · fork() 返回 0
note: 返回值不同，同一份代码因此走向不同分支
pills: Copy-on-Write, PID, 地址空间
foot: 复制的是“进程状态”，不是磁盘上的程序。
```
````

| 行 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `title:` / `sub:` | 居中标题 / 灰色副标题 |
| `arrow: 标签` 或 `arrow` | 竖向箭头，标签可省略 |
| `row` | 开始一行并列盒子，后续 `box` 归入该行 |
| `box [gray\|blue\|green\|amber\|plain] [wide]: 标题 \| 副标题` | 盒子；`wide` 强制整行 |
| `note:` / `pills:` / `foot:` / `gap` | 居中注释 / 胶囊标签 / 底部图注 / 空隙 |

### `%%tree`

````markdown
```tree
%%tree
systemd (PID 1)
  uvicorn.service | PID 1000
    Worker 1 | PID 1001
    Worker 2 | PID 1002
```
````

缩进两格一层；`标题 | 备注` 的备注以灰色小字跟在后面。

### `%%quiz`

````markdown
```quiz
%%quiz
tag: Linux 小测验
q: Linux 中，kill -9 发送的是什么信号？
A. SIGTERM (15)
B. SIGKILL (9)
C. SIGSTOP (19)
D. SIGINT (2)
answer: B
why: -9 就是 SIGKILL，内核直接终止，既不能捕获也不能忽略。
```
````

- 顶部是标签 + `第 n / N 题` + 进度条；
- 单选 → 「提交答案」→ 判分并展开解析 → 「下一题」；
- 最后一题后是成绩页：答对 x/N、逐题回顾、重做、复制结果；
- 加一行 `mode: list` 改为一次显示整卷。

| 关键字 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `q:` / `问题:` | 开始一道新题 |
| `A.` ~ `H.` | 选项 |
| `answer:` / `答案:` | 正确项 |
| `why:` / `解析:` | 判分后展示的解释 |
| `tag:` / `title:` | 卡片顶部标签 / 标题 |

## 工作原理

1. **识别**：读代码块第一行，`%%figure` / `%%tree` / `%%quiz` 决定用哪个渲染器；
2. **解析**：逐行读指令，生成中间结构——空行和 `#` 注释忽略，流式输出中未闭合的块按已有内容先渲染；
3. **渲染**：生成普通 DOM，颜色全部从 `currentColor` 派生，深浅主题共用一套规则；内容变化时原地替换旧节点；
4. **状态**：选择题的选项、当前题号、完成态写入 `localStorage`，键是块内容的哈希，刷新和重渲染都能恢复；
5. **调度**：`MutationObserver` 监听会话 DOM，出现新代码块就处理一次。

## 安装

```bash
# 1. 链进 profile
ln -s /path/to/dsh-chat-figure ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-chat-figure

# 2. 在 profile 的 patch 层追加一行
cat >> ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml <<'YAML'
- insert:
    - id: chat-figure
      name: 'dsh-chat-figure'
YAML
```

刷新页面即生效，无需重启 `dsh web`。

## 限制

- 仅支持 DSH Web，浏览器需支持 `color-mix()`（Chrome 111+ / Safari 16.2+ / Firefox 113+）；
- 渲染后会隐藏原始代码块，只显示图形；
- 不支持 Mermaid 语法；
- 判分在浏览器本地完成，模型看不到你的作答——用「复制结果」回传，或直接说明错题。

[更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 的按需 MCP 网关：server 只在被用到时连接，空闲自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，子进程环境自动脱敏。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lazy-mcp

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

A lazy-loading **MCP gateway** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). No MCP server starts at boot: each server connects on first use and is released after an idle window. Tools and resources are bridged into the model's tool catalog, and the Web UI shows live server state.

![The MCP status panel](assets/panel.png)

<sub>The status panel: per-server state, lifecycle, tool count, and the adjustable idle window.</sub>

## Why this exists

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` connects every configured server while the plugin activates and awaits the initial connection plus tool discovery, so:

- every server is live before the Harness's first turn;
- a slow or broken server delays startup;
- servers stay resident until the Harness restarts (its only `idle`-shaped knob, `reconnect.maxDelayMs`, governs reconnect backoff, not idle shutdown).

This gateway starts nothing at boot.

| Behaviour | `dsh-mcp-client` | this plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Server process at Harness startup | started | **not started** |
| Server starts | at plugin activation | **on first tool call that needs it** |
| Server stops | only on config reload / Harness restart | **after `idleDisconnectMs` idle** |
| Standing tool definitions | one per MCP tool, sent every request | **3 fixed gateway tools** |
| Tool schemas in context | all, always | **only when `mcp_tools` is called** |
| Describing a dormant server | requires a connection | **served from cached metadata** |
| Per-server lifecycle | one behaviour | **`lazy` / `lazy-keep-alive` / `eager` / `keep-alive`** |

## Install

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer and a DSH profile (the Web profile is the usual one). The package has **no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency**, so a Harness peer-range change cannot break it; its single runtime dependency is the MCP TypeScript client SDK, the same SDK the official bridge uses.

### Option A — install from GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp
```

Then **restart `dsh web`**. The Host half and the browser half are both loaded from the installed package, and a running Harness cannot pick up a freshly installed module without a restart.

### Option B — install a release tarball

Download `dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz` from the [Releases](https://github.com/zhe97396-tech/dsh-lazy-mcp/releases) page and install it through the plugin manager (or `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz`), then restart `dsh web`.

The plugin is enabled by an `- id: lazy-mcp` row in the profile. A configuration-only change normally hot-reloads, **but when it ships inside a replaced package the manager defers it to the restart** (the result reads `application: "restart-required"`). Toggling the row off and on — the plugin manager's `set_plugin` on `include:lazy-mcp` — forces a re-compose and applies the new configuration immediately, without a restart.

### Two halves

| Half | File | Loaded by |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | the bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` |
| Browser | `client.js` | the `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json`, served by `dsh-client-modules` |

The browser half imports **no DSH Client package**: React comes from the browser module table and every color is a theme token, so it follows light and dark without a second stylesheet. Its `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` uses the exact package name, which is why the package name, the Loader row name, and the naming manifest must be renamed together.

The two halves are wired only by the read-only JSON route the Host half registers at `/lazy-mcp/state` and by the shared panel id `lazy-mcp`.

### Where it actually lives

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Profile dependency + bundle list | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` |
| Installed package — a **real directory** with its own `node_modules` | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lazy-mcp` |
| Vendored tarball (only when installed from a tarball) | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/.local-packages/dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz` |
| Enablement override written by the plugin manager | `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (`- id: lazy-mcp`) |
| Source | this repository — **not read at runtime** |

The plugin's **settings** live in this package's own `cordis.patch.yml`, loaded as the bundle's patch layer — not in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. To override a setting from the profile layer instead, add an `- id: lazy-mcp` entry with a `config` there; the profile layer wins.

### Rebuilding after a code change

```sh
cd dsh-lazy-mcp
pnpm install
pnpm run check      # syntax check of both halves
pnpm run lint       # package identity / manifest consistency
pnpm run verify     # self-check harness (starts a real MCP reference server)
pnpm pack           # dsh-lazy-mcp-<version>.tgz
```

Bump `version` first, so the new artifact gets a distinct name and the old one can be pruned, then install that tarball through the plugin manager and restart `dsh web`.

## Configure

The package ships with **no servers configured** (`servers: []`), so nothing is spawned until you add entries to the `lazy-mcp` row's `config`:

```yaml
- id: lazy-mcp
  config:
    idleDisconnectMs: 600000        # disconnect a lazy server after 10 minutes idle
    connectTimeoutMs: 30000         # deadline for connect + tool discovery
    callTimeoutMs: 60000            # deadline for one tools/call
    # cachePath: !!js dshHomePath('lazy-mcp/tool-cache.json')   # default: <DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/lazy-mcp/tool-cache.json
    servers:
      - name: docs                  # ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$, unique
        transport: stdio
        lifecycle: lazy
        description: Documentation lookup
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'some-mcp-server']
        # env: { SOME_TOKEN: '...' }   # optional, merged over the scrubbed env
        # cwd: 'C:\path\to\project'    # optional
        # idleDisconnectMs: 120000     # optional per-server override

      - name: knowledge
        transport: streamable-http
        lifecycle: lazy
        description: Internal knowledge base
        url: https://mcp.example.com/rpc
        # headers: { Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' }
```

Every field is optional except a server's `name`, `transport`, and that transport's target (`command` for stdio, `url` for streamable-http). An invalid configuration fails activation with the exact offending path named.

### Environment scrubbing

A stdio server's child environment is the parent environment **minus** every name matching `KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN` (case-insensitive) and **minus** every `DSH_*` name, then merged with the server's explicit `env`. This matches the shipped subprocess seam's definition, so a child server never inherits this process's model credentials. A server that needs a secret must receive it through its own `env` mapping. **Env values are never logged and never written to the cache** — only the key set is, and only to detect a configuration change.

## Importing an existing MCP setup

Point `configPaths` at any JSON file containing a standard `mcpServers` object and its servers appear here. This is how an existing **Pi** (`pi-mcp-adapter`), **Claude Code**, **Cursor**, or **`.mcp.json`** setup becomes reusable without copying commands by hand — the other tool stays the source of truth.

```yaml
- id: lazy-mcp
  config:
    configPaths:
      - '~/.config/mcp/mcp.json'          # Pi shared config
      - '~/.pi/agent/mcp-adapter.json'    # Pi adapter config
```

Standard fields are translated: `command`/`args`/`env`/`cwd` become a stdio server, `url`/`headers` become a streamable-http server. A leading `~/` in a path, and `${VAR}` / `$VAR` in `args`, `cwd`, `env`, `headers`, and `url`, are expanded from the environment — an unknown name is left literal ra

> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: 拾页：DeepSeek Harness 本地小说阅读器侧栏插件 / Local TXT novel reader sidebar plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-novel-reader · 拾页

[![Plugin checks](https://github.com/qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏里，安静读一本本地小说。

**拾页**是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方小说阅读器插件。支持本地 TXT 书架、章节导航、章内进度、书签摘记及阅读外观设置；小说正文保存在设备本地，不发送给模型。

## 安装

兼容性基线：**DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**。上游仍在开发预览阶段，后续版本的插件接口可能变化。

1. 在 DeepSeek Harness 打开 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 输入以下 Git 安装地址：

   ```text
   git+https://github.com/qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader.git#v1.0.0
   ```

3. 完成安装并启用 **拾页 · 小说阅读器**；如提示需要重启，请重启应用。
4. 打开一个会话，在右侧栏开始页选择 **小说阅读器**。

仓库提交了构建好的 `lib/`，通过 Git 地址安装不需要在安装时执行构建脚本。插件包名是 `dsh-novel-reader`；本项目目前通过 GitHub 分发，不要求 npm 同名包已经发布。

也可下载源码后，在关闭 Harness 的状态下使用本地辅助安装器：

```sh
node install.mjs
```

辅助安装器安装到当前用户的 `.dsh/profiles/desktop`，遵循 `DSH_HOME` 环境变量；已有 manifest 会备份，用户的 profile patch 会保留。安装到自定义 profile：

```sh
node install.mjs --profile /absolute/path/to/profile
```

命令行用户也可以使用官方插件安装入口：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader
```

项目的 `engines.dsh` 精确声明已核对的 `0.2.1-rc.2`，尚未验证其他版本时不扩大兼容范围。

## 阅读功能

- **本地导入**：TXT / TEXT / MD 批量导入及拖放；每个文件小于 50 MB（50 × 1024 × 1024 字节）。MD 按纯文本显示。
- **编码兼容**：自动识别 UTF-8 和带 BOM 的 UTF-16，非 UTF-8 回退到 GB18030 / GBK；可手动指定 Big5、UTF-8、UTF-16 LE/BE。
- **书架与最近阅读**：按最近阅读排序、搜索书名、继续阅读、移除书籍；相同原文件通过 SHA-256 去重。
- **章节阅读**：识别中文章/回/卷和英文章名，支持目录定位。没有章名的文本按 180 行划分阅读节。
- **章内进度**：底部滑块只控制当前章节，全书进度独立显示；误操作可返回上次跳转前的位置。
- **章末翻页**：在正文结束处切换前后章，并显示下一章标题；章末可展开原文核对。
- **进度记忆**：保存段落及段内偏移；刷新后恢复位置。滚动时仅保存小型进度记录。
- **搜索**：全文文字搜索、结果定位、正文命中高亮；最多显示 200 条结果。
- **书签与摘记**：保存书签、选中文字写笔记、段落标记、定位、删除，以及导出当前书籍摘记 JSON。
- **阅读外观**：暖纸、素白、青竹、夜读四种主题；宋体/无衬线字体、12–32 字号、1.3–2.8 行距和自定义纯色背景。
- **侧栏适配**：响应式布局、空状态、导入和存储错误提示、键盘可操作控件。

乱码时，可在 **外观 → 下次导入编码** 选择正确编码，再次导入同一文件；采用不同手动编码重新导入时保留按行记录的进度和摘记。

## 数据与权限

书籍、设置、进度和摘记保存在当前应用来源的 IndexedDB。插件没有网络上传代码、模型工具或额外主进程接口；阅读不会把小说加入对话上下文。

清理应用数据、浏览器来源或更换设备会影响本地书架。请保留原始文本，需要时导出摘记。浏览器独立预览与桌面应用使用不同来源，书架数据相互隔离。

## 开发

需要 **Node.js 22+**。构建和本地测试仅使用 Node.js 标准库；`devDependencies` 记录兼容的 Harness 开发接口，不需要先安装它们即可执行以下检查。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader.git
cd dsh-novel-reader
npm run build
npm test
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```

独立预览：

```sh
python -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

打开 <http://127.0.0.1:8765/preview.html>，可导入仓库自写示例 `test/sample.txt`。同一份预览书架需使用相同的协议、主机和端口访问。

### 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/core.cjs` | 编码解码、章节识别和全文搜索 |
| `src/reader.js` | 阅读界面、书架、进度、设置、摘记和存储 |
| `src/reader.css` | 阅读排版、主题和响应式侧栏 |
| `build.mjs` | 生成 Harness 客户端模块 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主插件入口 |
| `lib/client.js` | 已构建客户端入口 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 注册 `ui-novel-reader` 插件行 |
| `locale/`、`icon.svg` | 插件管理器的展示名称、描述与图标 |
| `install.mjs` | 可选的本地 profile 安装辅助工具 |
| `test/` | 回归测试及自写示例文本 |

### 插件契约

插件通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明组合包，通过 `dsh.client` 和 `./client` 导出客户端入口，使用 Harness 提供的 React。客户端模块导出 `inject/apply`，通过 `sidebarRightTabs` 注册 `novel-reader` 类型，并在 `sidebar.right.pane.tab` slot 挂载界面。第三方标签使用 `extension` 优先级，注册和样式生命周期由 `ctx.effect` 管理。

参考上游：[官方打包与安装教程](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)、[插件展示元信息](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/cookbook/adding-a-package.zh.md#plugin-display-metadata)、[右侧栏浏览器插件](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/client/ui-sidebar-browser)。

### 检查范围

测试覆盖 UTF/GBK 解码、章节边界、正文重构完整性、搜索、客户端注册契约及本地安装器。还提供 manifest、exports、组合包 patch、locale、图标和分发文件检查。GitHub Actions 在 Windows / Linux、Node.js 22 / 24 上运行检查，并验证客户端构建产物已提交。

浏览器中验证过大文本导入、章内定位、误跳返回、章末翻页、刷新恢复和首尾章的原文一致性。实际桌面端激活、不同 Harness 版本与不同系统仍需相应运行环境验证；这些自动检查不代表 DeepSeek 官方审核或收录。

## Model Experience

None, as this plugin only renders a local reading interface and does not register model tools or prompt content.

#### KV Cache effect

No direct effect: reading state and novel text are not inserted into model requests.

## 已知限制

- 仅支持纯文本，不支持 EPUB、PDF、DOCX、在线抓书、OCR 或云同步。
- 编码检测和章节识别使用启发式规则；特殊文本可能需要手动选择编码或通过原文查看核对。
- 划线显示为所在段落的标记，并非逐字富文本批注；修改文件行结构可能影响原有定位。
- 多个会话或窗口之间没有书架实时合并，同一本书建议在一个阅读器内编辑。
- 本地存储容量、来源隔离、数据清理或文件本身缺失会影响阅读内容；插件不能补齐原始文件中没有的章节。
- 初始界面文案以简体中文为主；中英文 locale 提供插件管理器展示信息。
- 本插件为社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

## 参与与许可

欢迎提交 [Issue](https://github.com/qiufengsir/dsh-novel-reader/issues) 或 Pull Request，开发约定见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。请使用可公开分享的最小示例复现问题。

plugins.readme_text:
# Pink Bow Kitty

A soft pink bow-kitty theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.

![Pink Bow Kitty wallpaper](assets/kitty-pattern.svg)

## What it does

- Repaints the whole Web UI in a soft pink palette, with separate light and dark variants.
- Puts a hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper behind the shell, softened with a pink veil so text stays readable.
- Adds a bow-wearing kitty mascot under the composer and on the blank-session welcome screen.
- Ships a matching plugin icon plus English and Chinese display metadata.

## Install

This is a standard DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` and `dsh.client`, and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row.

- From the DSH plugin market: search for **Pink Bow Kitty** and install it from the Themes tab.
- Or install this repository as a bundle through the DSH plugin manager.

The theme applies immediately after the client plugin loads. Disable or remove the bundle to restore the stock UI exactly.

## Compatibility

Built against the DSH Web client's `theme` token-override service and the documented UI slots (`shell.overlay`, `conversation.composer.dock`, `conversation.hero.brand.mark`). No DeepSeek Harness client package is imported.

## Artwork

All artwork in this repository is original vector art drawn for this plugin: the kitty faces, the repeating wallpaper, and the plugin icon. No third-party characters or images are bundled.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: ClinePass model provider — seeds the llm-pi-ai `clinepass` route (endpoint, protocol, credential ref, 12-model catalog) so the Models settings page needs only the API key.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-clinepass

**Adds [ClinePass](https://docs.cline.bot/getting-started/clinepass) as a model provider to DeepSeek
Harness: once installed, one API key in Settings → Models is all it takes.**

ClinePass is Cline's low-cost subscription tier ($9.99/month, 2–5x usage on popular open coding
models). It speaks the regular Cline API (`https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`, OpenAI Chat Completions)
under `cline-pass/*` model slugs. DSH's provider catalog ships nothing under that name, so this
small bundle registers it as a first-class `llm-pi-ai` route.

## What you get

Everything runs through DSH's native paths:

- a **ClinePass** card on **Settings → Models** whose only primary field is the **API key**
  (the collapsed 自定义设置 area still edits endpoint, protocol, and the model list);
- the current ClinePass subscription models (`cline-pass/glm-5.3`, `cline-pass/kimi-k3`,
  `cline-pass/deepseek-v4-pro`, …) in the model picker — **fetched live**, never hardcoded;
- **fetch available models** on the card answers with what the subscription sources publish right
  now instead of the endpoint's usage-billing listing (see below).

> **Why isn't ClinePass in the "add provider" dropdown?** That select lists only *unconfigured*
> directory providers (an adoption entry). The plugin pre-seeds ClinePass as a configured provider
> card, so it is not in the dropdown and never needs to be picked from it — open Settings → Models
> and the card is already there, same as any hand-declared route.

## Install

```bash
# Option A: hot-assemble with the dev injector (no restart; also records the
# bundle in the profile's bundle list)
#   dev_install_package /path/to/dsh-plugin-clinepass --profile web

# Option B: manual
#   1) add this directory to the profile dependencies (link or file) and to
#      dsh.profile.bundles;
#   2) restart DSH.
```

On activation the plugin seeds the route into the `llm-pi-ai` settings user layer — the very write
the Models page itself performs, persisted in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — and then all that
remains is:

**Settings → Models → ClinePass → paste the API key (app.cline.bot → Settings → API Keys) → Apply**

## What it does / does not do

| Does | Does not |
| --- | --- |
| idempotently seed the `clinepass` route (endpoint, protocol, display name, credential ref, live-fetched models) | touch dsh source or any other route |
| scope "fetch available models" to `cline-pass/*` slugs | own key storage (native credentials service does) |
| then hand everything to the native Models page / credentials / streaming adapter | overwrite configuration you already have |

Seeding is **idempotent and non-destructive**: once the route key resolves (hand-tuned on the
Models page or written into `cordis.patch.yml`), the plugin never writes it again. Set `seed: false`
in the plugin config to disable seeding entirely.

**Route-key collisions**: if `routeKey` already names a provider in the llm runtime's directory —
the installed catalog owns it, or another plugin registered it — seeding is refused with one warning
instead of shadowing that route's endpoint, protocol, and credential reference (which would also
collide in llm-pi-ai's directory commit). Pick a free key, or set `allowReservedRouteKey: true` to
take the key over deliberately. The warning is per seed run, not per activation: a plugin-config
edit re-runs the seed, so an unchanged bad key warns again — that is what surfaces a newly picked
reserved key. The guard is best-effort: if the directory cannot be read at all, the seed proceeds
with a note in the log rather than blocking, since an unreadable directory is no reason to leave the
route unseeded.

**Removal semantics**: the card is removable on the Models page (the route lives in the user layer
only). A removal takes effect and is respected for the rest of the session; the next activation
(restart or hot reload) finds the route missing and re-seeds it. To retire the card for good, set
`seed: false` instead of deleting it.

## Probed spec table (corrections, not a catalog)

The model list itself is always fetched live (see the next section). What the plugin ships is a
**probed-facts table** that only *corrects* fetched rows for ids it knows: `input` (text/image) is
probed fact — one image and one text request per model against the live API on 2026-09-29:

| Model | id | context | max output | image |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GLM-5.3 | `cline-pass/glm-5.3` | 1,000,000 | 131,072 | ✅ |
| GLM-5.3 Flash | `cline-pass/glm-5.3-flash` | 1,000,000 | 131,072 | ✅ |
| Kimi K3 | `cline-pass/kimi-k3` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ✅ |
| DeepSeek V4 Pro | `cline-pass/deepseek-v4-pro` | 1,000,000 | 384,000 | ✅ |
| DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | — (conservative default) | — (conservative default) | ✅ |
| MiMo-V2.5 | `cline-pass/mimo-v2.5` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ✅ |
| MiMo-V2.5-Pro | `cline-pass/mimo-v2.5-pro` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ❌ rejects image input |
| MiniMax M3 | `cline-pass/minimax-m3` | 1,048,576 | 512,000 | ✅ |
| Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor | `cline-pass/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ⚠️ catalog consensus; region-locked, unprobed |
| Qwen3.8 Max | `cline-pass/qwen3.8-max` | 1,000,000 | 131,072 | ✅ |
| Qwen3.7 Max | `cline-pass/qwen3.7-max` | 1,000,000 | 131,072 | ❌ rejects image input |
| Qwen3.7 Plus | `cline-pass/qwen3.7-plus` | 1,000,000 | 65,536 | ✅ |

**Where the specs come from (why they cannot be fetched from ClinePass)**: Cline publishes no
per-model specs on any API-key-accessible endpoint — `GET /api/v1/models` carries only
`id/object/created/owned_by`, the model-detail endpoints require the app's account session, and
the docs table has no parameter columns. The context/output values above are **inherited from the
pi-ai builtin catalog** (2026-09-29; vendor-official entries preferred — moonshotai, deepseek,
xiaomi, minimax, qwen-token-plan — then the coding-plan aggregator opencode-go), while the image
column is **probed per model against the live ClinePass API** (more accurate than the catalog,
which declares GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro text-only although Cline's deployment serves images).
`deepseek-v4.1-flash` has no catalog entry anywhere, so it keeps llm-pi-ai's conservative defaults
(262144/32768): under-reporting only compacts earlier and can never overflow the context.

**Spec auto-fill**: on every activation the plugin fills only *absent* spec fields on the existing
route — values anyone set and models anyone added or removed are never touched. The fill source is
this probed table (or your pinned `models` list), never a registry claim. Upgrading the plugin
needs no action: the next activation fills whatever new specs the release ships.

## Why "fetch available models" is wrapped

Cline's `GET /api/v1/models` enumerates the **usage-billing catalog** (vendor slugs like
`zai/glm-5.3`, 464 entries, re-verified 2026-10-06 to contain no `cline-pass/*` ids). Subscription
models use the `cline-pass/*` alias namespace (verified: `cline-pass/glm-5.3` routes to
`zai/glm-5.3` underneath). Passing the listing through would let users adopt slugs that do not count
against the subscription, so the card's discovery answer is scoped to `cline-pass/*` ids.

**The model list is fetched, never shipped.** The source of truth is the **plan catalog from the
[models.dev](https://models.dev/providers/cline-pass/) `cline-pass` provider** — 18 models as of
2026-10-06, including `mimo-v2.6-pro`, `mimo-v2.6-flash`, `kimi-k2.6`, `kimi-k2.7-code`, `glm-5.2`
and `deepseek-v4-flash` — merged with any `cline-pass/*` id the endpoint probe returns. The same
fetch populates the route's model list at seed time. A model Cline adds needs no plugin release:
it shows up on the next "fetch available models" (six-hour cache). There is deliberately **no
bundled fallback list**: if every source is unreachable the answer is empty (with a warn log)
rather than a stale catalog claiming models the plan may no longer carry — the one exception is an
operator-pinned `models` list, which is explicit intent and always leads the answer.

**Probed facts still win over catalog claims.** Where the probed table knows an id, it

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: ⚡ DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调上下文（1M）、勾多模态发图、配思考强度档位（low/high/max）的繁琐痛点，新增模型保存即自动搞定！
plugins.readme_text:
# ⚡ DSH 模型补齐助手（dsh-model-auto-enricher）

**告别在 DSH 里加完模型渠道后，还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调上下文、勾图片、配思考强度的繁琐苦力活！**

---

## 😫 为什么做这个插件？（真实痛点）

在 DSH 里每添加一个新的中转站或第三方 API 渠道，里面往往有十几个甚至几十个模型。
但是在 DSH 默认设置界面里，拉取或添加完模型后，**每一个模型都得你自己手动点开去调**：
- 要一个个手填 **上下文窗口**（默认是空的，或者被限制在 128k / 200k，不改很快就会爆上下文）；
- 要一个个手填 **最大输出 Token**（默认是空的）；
- 要一个个手动勾选 **「图片」多模态开关**（默认只勾了纯文本，不勾根本发不了截图）；
- 要一个个手动打开 **「推理等级」开关** 并添加 `max` 档位（默认没开，开了也只有 `low / medium / high`，没有最高 `max` 档）。

**十几个模型一个个点开改下来，又麻烦又累；以后每次往渠道里新加一两个模型，还得再重复折腾一遍！**

装上 **「DSH 模型补齐助手」** 后：
👉 **你只需要在设置里把渠道和模型加进去、点一下保存，剩下的调上下文（100 万）、开多模态发图、配思考强度档位（`low / high / max`）全部由插件在后台自动帮你一次性搞定！**

---

## 🛠️ 具体帮你省掉哪些手动操作？

| 你以前要手动挨个调的项 | DSH 默认刚加进来时 | 装上本插件后（全自动） |
|---|---|---|
| **1. 调上下文容量** | 空白未填，或被截断在 `128k` / `200k` / `256k` | 自动全部拉满到 **100 万长上下文（`1,000,000`）** |
| **2. 调最大输出** | 空白未填 | 自动按系列补齐 **`64,000` / `128,000`** 最大输出 |
| **3. 调多模态（发图）** | 默认只勾了「文本」，聊天框发不了图 | 自动为所有模型勾选 **「文本 + 图片」（`[text, image]`）** |
| **4. 调思考强度档位** | 默认关闭，或手动打开后缺少 `max` 档 | 自动配齐 **`{ low, high, max }` 思考强度档位**（并保留已有自定义档位） |

---

## ✨ 核心亮点（v2.0 中文友好 · 全自动版）

1. **⚡ 添加新模型保存即自动生效（无需手动点按钮、无需重启 DSH）**
   - 插件在后台自动监听 DSH 的模型设置保存事件。
   - 只要你在 **「设置 → 模型」** 里添加了新模型并点击「应用」，插件会在 **0.6 秒内自动在后台帮你把百万上下文、64k+ 最大输出、发图支持、思考档位全部补齐**，并立即热重载生效！
2. **🧠 认识所有新模型（内置全系列规则 + 通用新模型兜底）**
   - 不仅完整识别 **GPT-4o / GPT-5 / GPT-6 / o1~o9 / Codex**、**Claude 4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 5 / 5.5+ (Opus / Sonnet)**、**Gemini 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4**、**DeepSeek V3 / V4 / V4.1 / R1 / R2**、**GLM 5 / 5.2 / 5.3 / Z1**、**Kimi K2.6 / K2.7 / K2.8 / K3**、**腾讯混元 Hy3 / Hy4**、**MiniMax / Step / Qwen / Grok / 豆包 / Llama / Mistral** 等全系模型；
   - **哪怕是你以后新加的、名字从来没见过的全新模型或内部代号模型**（如 `space-bunny`、`argon`、`astra`、`sol` 等），也会自动触发**「通用新模型规则」**，默认按顶配规格（`1M 上下文 + 64k 最大输出 + 支持发图 + low/high/max 思考档位`）一步到位补齐！
3. **🛡️ 100% 安全，只升不降，写前自动备份**
   - **只升不降**：如果你某个模型已经设了更大的上下文或更大的输出（如 `128000`），绝不会给你改小；已有的自定义思考档位（如 `off`、`medium`、`xhigh`）一律原样保留。
   - **自动备份**：每次修改配置文件前，都会自动在同目录生成带时间戳的备份文件（`cordis.patch.yml.bak-auto-enrich-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss`）。
   - **严格幂等**：所有模型已经是最佳状态时，不会改动任何字节，也不会产生多余备份。
4. **🖥️ 内置可视化管理面板（设置 → 模型补齐助手）**
   - 在 DSH 设置页左侧导航栏新增 **「模型补齐助手」** 面板，随时查看所有渠道与模型的健康状态、识别系列标签、上下文容量、多模态与思考档位明细，也支持手动一键补齐。

---

## 📦 一键安装

### 方式一：在 DSH 插件市场（dshmarket）中安装
打开 DSH **设置 → 插件市场**，搜索 **`dsh-model-auto-enricher`** 或 **模型补齐助手**，点击**安装**即可。

### 方式二：命令行一键安装

桌面版（`desktop` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

网页版（`web` profile）：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
```

---
